# FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
JANUARY 25, 2024
#
CONTACT: press@kevinfaulconer.com

**Downtown San Diego Partnership Endorses Kevin Faulconer For Supervisor**
SAN DIEGO, CA – The Downtown San Diego Partnership this week endorsed former Mayor Kevin Faulconer over incumbent Terra Lawson-Remer in the district three race for County Supervisor. The endorsement comes after Faulconer announced he outraised Lawson-Remer indicating momentum continues to be on his side:
**“Kevin Faulconer has a demonstrated history of championing innovative policies that drive the economic prosperity and cultural vibrancy of Downtown San Diego. Through the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic, ongoing homelessness crisis, and public safety concerns, Former City of San Diego Mayor Faulconer has consistently proven himself to be a reliable and steadfast leader, ” said Betsy Brennan, President and CEO of the Downtown San Diego Partnership.**
**“I’m proud to receive the endorsement of an organization that is so important to the fabric of our county,” said former Mayor Kevin Faulconer. “They’re not only seeing the same problems when it comes to growing tent encampments throughout our region, but they’re doing something about it day in and day out. As Supervisor, I’ll work with important voices like the Downtown San Diego Partnership to help clean up our streets and get people living in unsanitary and unsafe conditions the help they need and deserve. I did it as Mayor of San Diego and I’ll do it again as your next Supervisor.”**
Since entering the race in July of 2023, Faulconer has attracted a growing number of endorsements from local organizations, including San Diego Working Waterfront, The Lincoln Club Business League, the San Diego Restaurant Association, the Building Industry Association, the Associated General Contractors of San Diego, and Associated Builders and Contractors of San Diego. As Supervisor, he’ll lead on pressing issues like homelessness on day one – working to clean up the streets and get people the help they need to turn their lives around, just as he did as Mayor of San Diego, where he presided over double-digit decreases in homelessness.
To learn more about Kevin Faulconer and his campaign for Supervisor, visit www.kevinfaulconer.com###

subject: re: The Consumer Financial Protection Bureau
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Big banks have made an art out of abusing overdraft fees, but the CFPB is fighting back.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1909%2E4032634%2E1Vm3Y9)
---
If you had a boat, what would you name it? Maybe you’d pick a spiffy-sounding word, like “Majestic.” Or maybe you’d pay tribute to someone or something you love, like one bank CEO did. He named his boat after something close to his heart: “Overdraft.” The bank he ran was notorious for padding profits by tricking consumers into expensive overdraft charges. Their practices were so egregious that the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) sued them. Too many banks have made an art out of juicing their profits by abusing the overdraft system — hiking fees up to be significantly more than it costs the bank to cover the transaction, or even charging fees when consumers actually had enough money in the bank to cover the withdrawals. But the CFPB is fighting back — and it’s part of the Biden-Harris administration’s work to cut junk fees and lower costs for American families. **Just last week, the CFPB announced a plan to slash overdraft fees to as little as $3, which could save consumers more than $3.5 billion a year.** Instead of helping CEOs buy new boats on the backs of people they cheated, that’s helping working families stay afloat. That’s just the start. The CFPB recently got big financial institutions to return $140 million in illegal junk fees to the people they cheated. And the agency is working to curb excessive credit card late fees, stop banks from charging illegal fees for regular customer service, and remove medical debt from credit reports. These are new additions to a proud legacy. Since its founding, the CFPB has handled nearly 4 million consumer complaints and forced big financial companies to return over $17 billion directly to Americans they cheated. Service members, veterans, seniors, students and millions of regular families have gotten help from the CFPB. For families on a budget, getting their money back is a very big deal. Success stories like these remind me why we fought so hard to create the CFPB as part of Wall Street reform. This agency is a perfect example of how we can put government on the side of families. And I will keep fighting to protect it from Republican attacks — including the lawsuit they launched to try to strike down the whole agency. [**There’s plenty more we need to do to put money and power in the hands of working people. I’m running for re-election to stay in the fight, and to keep making big, structural change like making the CFPB a reality. If you can, please make a donation to help grow our campaign and fuel this fight.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1875?t=8&akid=1909%2E4032634%2E1Vm3Y9)

Friend, since the first Social Security check was issued nearly 84 years ago, tens of millions of Americans have benefited from this critical program. Today, more than 66 million Americans rely on the Social Security benefits _they earned_ to protect their livelihoods and families. For so many, Social Security is a lifeline. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1062%2E135344%2EMh_TOG)

Hi team,
This month marks 14 years since the Supreme Court's Citizens United decision, so I thought I’d give you a quick rundown of what exactly happened with that fateful decision and just how deeply it’s impacted our politics.
Back in 2010, in a case called _Citizens United v. FEC_ , the Supreme Court ruled in a 5-4 decision that political contributions of corporations are protected under the First Amendment. That means that a contribution a corporation makes to a political campaign is considered speech—like that of individuals—and that the government has a very limited ability to regulate that speech.
Since the ruling, spending by outside groups in politics has skyrocketed. Campaign spending by corporations and other outside groups went up by nearly 900% between 2008 and 2016. In 2020, total spending was $14.4 billion. That one decision has deeply expanded the influence of wealthy individuals and big corporations—and it has ultimately led to a lot of the dysfunction that so many people hate about politics.
After that decision, like it or not, campaigns cost money. It’s how candidates are able to host events, reach out to voters, and—maybe most importantly—buy ads, which are very expensive but are one of the best ways to get in front of voters. After Citizens United, we have a system where corporations can spend as much as they want to help candidates that support their policy positions — and that money is often enough to win elections.
So what do we do now to stop the flood of special interest money that has completely infiltrated our political system? One thing is to support candidates who refuse to accept it.
I am one of 73 members of Congress who refuses to accept any corporate PAC money. This way, the people of Michigan know that I’m voting my conscience — not in the way that a corporation may want me to, to further their bottom line.
The other thing we need to do is keep control of the Senate. If Supreme Court seats come up in the next few years, it’s imperative we have 50 senators who actively want Citizens United repealed.
It's one of the reasons why I’m running for Senate here in Michigan—to be an advocate for the people of our state and to rebalance our political system in favor of regular people.
[**But for now, we need to raise a ton of money to defeat our Republican opponents who accept truckloads of corporate PAC money. That’s why we’re in your inbox all the time and why I’m asking you to chip in $3 to our campaign today.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240125-2-15&t=2&akid=1062%2E135344%2EMh_TOG)**

| **Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association PAC Endorses John Duarte for Congress**
---
| | **Modesto **— Today, the Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association PAC endorsed John Duarte for Congress. Founded in 1978, The Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association is dedicated to the protection of Proposition 13 and the advancement of taxpayers’ rights, including fighting against raising taxes in California.

Following the endorsement, John Duarte commented, “Hard-working people are struggling from inflation and the high costs of gas and groceries. We must protect policies like Proposition 13 that provide tax relief for Californians across our state. I am thankful to have earned an endorsement from the Howard Jarvis Taxpayers Association. I look forward to continuing to find solutions that puts more money back into the pockets of Valley families.”

The endorsement is a testament to Duarte’s strong and constant support for Proposition 13 and his excellent service to taxpayers. For more information about John Duarte or the campaign, please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=9415e87c0b&e=76a47b375f).

clean_body: Despite the likelihood that my Senate race will be the most expensive in history, I can't even cobble together $1.000 per day. | | Fellow Conservative, I’ve been in this race for seven months, and . I’ve shared my life story and explained why I’m running for the United States Senate. And I believe I have done a good job detailing why my Senate race in Montana is the most important in the country (it will be the one to decide which party controls the Senate). Yet, my pleas for help has gone unnoticed. I didn’t think setting a goal of raising $1,000 on Sunday was particularly high, yet we still couldn’t cobble together the money. Fellow Conservative, you may not know me well, if at all, but I’m telling you that I’m the one person in the way of Democrats controlling the Senate. Please trust me when I say they are preparing to make this the most expensive Senate race in U.S. history. Right now, in January, Dems are spending against me at the rate of $1 million per month. Soon, it’s likely to be $1 million per week. So when I say, it’s not a lie. Please to help me make up the difference from missing our goal on Sunday. name: Hirono HQ
subject: We’re not sure what’s going on…
body:
|
#
We're not quite sure what's going on, Peter. Our grassroots momentum has slowed down more than expected recently, and even though we’re less than a week away from our first end-of-month deadline of the year, it doesn’t seem to be picking up at all. We’re not sure if it’s because Election Day still feels far ahead in the future, if the GOP presidential primary is grabbing most of the attention, or if it’s something else entirely. **Whatever it is, it needs to change fast — because in a political system dominated by shady dark money donors and billionaire-funded Super PACs, there’s so such thing as cruising to victory. If we’re going to re-elect Mazie, we have to fight for every single vote.** We’ve seen this play out in Hawaii before. In the 2022 midterms, special interest donors spent _millions_ of dollars boosting their preferred candidates — attempting to buy votes rather than _earn_ them. **And since Mazie is the only immigrant serving in the Senate who is unapologetically fighting for a living wage, reproductive freedom, affordable healthcare, and bold climate action — there’s no shortage of powerful people who would be willing to spend whatever it takes to unseat her.** **[Thankfully, we still have time to right this ship before next week’s end-of-month deadline. So Peter, will you chip in $10 to help us protect our razor-thin Senate majority and sustain Mazie’s progressive fight for our working families, our planet, and our future?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77756310/451413865/296097457?amount=10&refcode=AU_MKH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20240125_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0M2I4MGIxNS1mMGJiLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IAJOcuiJRZtdKfxPr2Jwh8hFxWgBfO2ueiqZ3VnLBIA=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | ******[Chip in $10 now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77756311/451413866/296097457?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_MKH_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20240125_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0M2I4MGIxNS1mMGJiLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IAJOcuiJRZtdKfxPr2Jwh8hFxWgBfO2ueiqZ3VnLBIA=)******

Friend,

All too often, our politicians say one thing and do another, Friend. They make promises they can’t keep, and wind up only following their own partisan agendas, leaving our communities out to dry. **Are you tired of that same old status quo?**

| [IT’S TIME FOR A CHANGE IN NV-04. HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT!](https://johnleeforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18876e295d2df144af23d05e5&id=d9e1b09d7f&e=91a702298f)
---
I am, too. That’s why I’m running my campaign differently. Here are a few issues that I pledge to you I WILL work to solve as your next Congressman in NV-04. _You have my word._
**–Work to Lower Prices and End Bidenomics.** I’ll implement the same conservative principles that made my small business successful and helped me turn around North Las Vegas as Mayor in order to lower costs for Nevadans.
**–Secure the Southern Border.** Thanks to Joe Biden’s Open Border policies – and the help of his allies like Steven Horsford who vote against securing the border – we’re now facing a crisis that has resulted in over 6.4 million illegal migrant encounters since the start of this administration. I’ll work to undo this mess and get us back to the border policies that worked.
**–Keep Our Streets Safe.** I will work to instill Law and Order in our Nevada communities instead of catering to criminals with more soft-on-crime policies.
This is my pledge to you, Friend. I’ve got the results to back it up from my time turning around North Las Vegas. But I need your support in order to continue this important work in Congress. [**So can I count on you to back my campaign today with a contribution?**](https://johnleeforcongress.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18876e295d2df144af23d05e5&id=44d0f75cb7&e=91a702298f)

---
**Thank you for the support,**_Fmr. Mayor John J. Lee_ Candidate for Congress, NV-04

# Take your Health Back!
Alright, everybody, strap in because I've got something absolutely mind-blowing to share with you, especially all my folks in California and the surrounding areas. This is not your average health benefit – we're talking about a game-changer! Now, I've been through the wringer when it comes to health. Yeah, I shed a whopping 500 pounds recently, but guess what? The battle's far from over. My body's still screaming in pain, and I'm staring down the barrel of two knee replacements. Back and hips? They're on a constant pain playlist, and the list of issues just keeps growing. So, what do you do when the traditional pharmaceutical game doesn't cut it? You dig deep, you research, and you look for alternatives. And let me tell you, my skepticism led me to a revelation that's going to blow your minds!
About a month back, my buddy of 20 years, Pastor James Fortune, hit me up with news that changed the game for him and his wife, Canada. They discovered a treatment so good, it sounds too good to be true. But hold on – it's legit! We're talking medical documents, x-rays, blood tests – the whole nine yards. I practically dragged Pastor James Fortune to Los Angeles because I knew you needed to hear this. We're hosting him at not one, but two locations in LA County. Picture this: an amazing catered dinner on us, and all the info you need to make educated decisions about taking charge of your health and living your absolute best life right now. Don't procrastinate until your body breaks down even more. It's time to restore your youth, break free from the pain, and live the life you've been dreaming of. It is indeed an honor to be aligned with like-minded conservative Republicans who share our mission to Save the Nation. Our commitment extends to restoring the nucleus family, preserving parental rights, safeguarding the right to life, and securing our borders for a stronger future.

For a more interactive engagement, I invite you to connect with me on social media through the links below. Your active participation and support are crucial as we work together to preserve the principles that define our beautiful nation.

Thank you for your continued support. Together, let us actively participate and contribute to the betterment of our great nation.
Best regards,

## 66th Assembly Central Committee

Dear friends and fellow Conservatives,
I am thrilled to announce that I am running for an official seat on the 66th Assembly District Central Committee. As some of you may know, I have been serving as an alternate on the committee for some time now. Over the past two years, I have also been actively involved in multiple posts within the party. I am proud to have been elected to the California Republican Assembly state board of directors as the Senate director for the 24th District, chaired the Faith Outreach committee for the CRA, and served as a delegate for the California State party. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the values and principles that are important to our party and have prepared me to effectively represent our district on the central committee.
As a member of the central committee, I will work tirelessly to ensure that conservative values remain at the forefront of our party's agenda. I believe that my position on the LAGOP, which is the largest Republican party office in the nation, will allow me to have a greater impact on decisions that affect our party and our community. I have already been able to influence many decisions as an alternate, and I am confident that I can make an even greater impact as an elected member.
While some have urged me to run for the congressional seat of the 36th district, I believe that my calling is to bring balance to the party for the next few years. This will not only benefit the party but also other candidates and myself in the long run. Federal races can be expensive to operate, and I have learned from my previous run for Congress that it takes time to build relationships and secure the support needed to win. My goal is to help fix the foundation of the party while building relationships with those who can help me in the future.
I am asking for your prayers and support as I take this important step on my journey. Please look for me on the primary ballot on March 5, 2024. Early voting begins on February 24, 2024. Your vote for me, Derrick R. Gates, for the 66th Assembly Central Committee, will help ensure that our conservative values continue to be represented in our district and beyond.
Thank you for your support and dedication to our party.
Sincerely,
Derrick R. Gates

clean_body: Despite the likelihood that my Senate race will be the most expensive in history, I can't even cobble together $1.000 per day. | | Peter, I’ve been in this race for seven months, and . I’ve shared my life story and explained why I’m running for the United States Senate. And I believe I have done a good job detailing why my Senate race in Montana is the most important in the country (it will be the one to decide which party controls the Senate). Yet, my pleas for help has gone unnoticed. I didn’t think setting a goal of raising $1,000 on Sunday was particularly high, yet we still couldn’t cobble together the money. Peter, you may not know me well, if at all, but I’m telling you that I’m the one person in the way of Democrats controlling the Senate. Please trust me when I say they are preparing to make this the most expensive Senate race in U.S. history. Right now, in January, Dems are spending against me at the rate of $1 million per month. Soon, it’s likely to be $1 million per week. So when I say, it’s not a lie. Please to help me make up the difference from missing our goal on Sunday. body:
Senate testimony stated a shocking rape and murder rate in Maryland. And the Texas Border Crisis is our Crisis. | | | |
---
| | |
# Ryan's Maryland Story and the Texas Border Crisis Shows the Urgent Need for Proven America First Leadership.
---
|
---
|
---
|
[](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=278bc8d4db&e=5bb5efcda7) Friend,
The Biden Administration and Democrats in Maryland and DC are exposing our children to the highest rates of murder and rape in decades - and the wide open Border is allowing the cartel murdering gangs to take over our streets.

The Maryland Senate this week [heard testimony of MD crime rates spiking](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=30bf918cfb&e=5bb5efcda7) over 46% for rape and 35% for murder. Juvenile-committed murders and shootings spiked the most at a near 77% increase, with over 171 juvenile shootings in 2022 alone. These are some of the highest crime rates in our nation.

And a young Catholic volunteer, Ryan Realbuto, age 23, who volunteered as part of a year-long catholic mission at Don Bosco Cristo Rey High School in Takoma Park, Maryland,******[was shot dead in a random street-side robbery while walking home from a youth meeting at church](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=cc4c32d5e4&e=5bb5efcda7)** on the DC/Maryland border at the 5000 block of South Dakota Ave. blocks away from Takoma Park and not far from the University of Maryland at Adelphi. His mother Janet said he was an amazing young man, the youngest of three brothers, and that their lives are shattered.
Earlier today Texas has formally told the Biden administration where to go while properly standing up its State Militia, [using the Constitution's supreme authority](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=016dd1fa10&e=5bb5efcda7) for State's to defend themselves from invasion under Article IV, sec. 4 and Article 1, sec. 10. At least 25 of our nation's Governors are standing with Texas and against the Biden administration's illegal scheme to overthrow our law and order. Biden and every one of his Democrat cronies running for Congress as my opponents are allowing evil human trafficking and the killing of Americans with the Open Border. They alone are responsible for Maryland's skyrocketing murder and rape crime rates.

It is time to elect a Republican who has been proven in the public Arena to stand against these practices with experience and effective opposition and leadership to save lives.

That is why I am running. I have actually fought for and voted for increased police protection and funding for our streets and law enforcement. I have fought on the House Floor and in Committee to end the illegal sanctuary state. _And I will do so in Congress_.

This week my extreme Democrat opponent announced she had raised $500,000 in her bid to buy this seat from out of district. Extreme leftists seeking to buy the seat from money raised primarily from far left regions of California and New York and international corporations will never fight for the lives of your children and grandchildren, and for the right to live, work and raise a family here in peace and safety, with low taxes and prosperity, like each of our families deserve. [](https://coxforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=dbb4b67212&e=5bb5efcda7)
As your Congressman, I will be a voice of reason and safety for all of Maryland.

Thanks to patriots such as you, I have already invested millions in name ID and ground game work in the last two years. All I need in this race to win is the war chest to defeat the liberal Democrats' lies and false promises, your strong support and the blessing of Almighty God.

It's now or never. I need your help this First Quarter of 2024 to stay on track in our fundraising. Would you help me tonight with your best contribution?

Thank you and God bless you. And God bless America.
Freedom and victory,

Dan Cox, Candidate for Congress (MD-CD6)

| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zf0r7m40jfdj38aprcoashcssqcngv04fragvhf0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9hm6p75chh2bs)****on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

name: Your America
subject: How to defend the Constitution
body:
You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39568%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=HMutj5x7SD96TwJUTArNFw&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest--with an Ivy League degree--said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39569%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4IU3AsHS0fCxcME9Ru7cwQ&sysid=1)**** on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39560%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rma5mp7B7tRMcKvRxSY4zw&sysid=1)
---
| | _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. Hillsdale’s faculty teach the course, and it will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. These DVDs also make a great gift for someone unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles--maybe even a friend or family member. But supplies are limited. So, be sure to get this special edition of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ on DVD today. More than 200,000 people have already taken this course, so this DVD box set won’t last long. You can use this secure link to receive your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ right now: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c39561%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=6d0mWn1WaXdBILBbF8FOkA&sysid=1) Warm regards, Bill Gray, ’01 Vice President National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

A few years ago, members of the world’s elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, “We need a ‘Great Reset’ of capitalism.” If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that’s not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I don’t want to have to do this. . .
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’m not going to sugarcoat this: _2024 could be the most critical year the pro-life movement has EVER faced._

The Abortion Lobby and their pals in the press are already busy writing the pro-life movement’s obituary – _as if everything that will happen in 2024 has already been decided!_

Pro-Life Friend, with everything _Students for Life Action_ has on our plates right now, I’m facing some very hard choices.

**As I write to you, I don’t have the money to fund all the admittedly, ambitious plans _Students for Life Action_ has laid for 2024.**

And if that doesn’t change quickly, I’m going to make cuts to our key programs.

That’s why, as one of our most trusted supporters, I need your IMMEDIATE advice . . .

I’m counting on you and a handful of other supporters to fill out their _Students for Life Action_ _Supporter Ballots_ to tell me where to make cuts.

There are several key areas that are essential to success in 2024 I might have to cut back on if I can’t raise the funds to support them. As it currently stands, I have four options:

**1. _Youth Voter Outreach_**

One of the best things we’ve been able to do in recent years is turn droves of young people away from the Abortion Lobby and towards the Pro-Life Movement.

And as a result, a whopping 10-15% of pro-abortion/on-the-fence young people leave the pro-abortion camp with every campus we visit!

In fact, a recent YouGov Poll we conducted showed that **two thirds** of young voter’s support limits on abortion. Not only that, but only **1 in 10** young voters hold the same extreme abortion views as the radical Democrat Party Platform, and **9 in 10** completely reject the Biden administration’s reckless chemical abortion policies.

This is supported by a recent _Rolling Stone_ article I read titled “Biden Bleeds Younger Voters,” which shows that the President now trails in several key swing states because young people are souring on him _en masse!_

_I knew this would happen._

During last year’s referendum fight in Ohio, we were able to convert pro-abortion young people to the pro-life side for just $12 per voter.

The problem is we just couldn’t raise enough money to WIN!

The results were a tragedy for Ohio.

I can’t bear to see the same thing happen to our country.

Pro-Life Friend, our programs reaching out to young voters could not be more crucial as we move closer to the elections this fall, as they will be the future of the Pro-Life Movement.

But, if you think we should pull back on our efforts to tell young people the TRUTH about abortion, then mark: **“STOP TURNING YOUNG PEOPLE AGAINST ABORTION”** on your _Supporter Ballot._

**[STOP TURNING YOUNG PEOPLE AGAINST ABORTION >>](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdiuuht-duchtdja-y/)**
**2. _State Legislative Battles_**

Since _Roe v. Wade_ was tossed onto the ash heap of history, the Abortion Lobby has been ramping up its efforts at the state level to push its radical abortion agenda.

State battles are our quickest path to saving lives at the moment with Republicans in Congress currently cowering to the Abortion Lobby.

In fact, media elites were ENRAGED earlier this year when studies showed that at least 10,000 more Texans were born in 2023 than expected.

They’re actually angry these babies weren’t killed! In one article, they blamed a shortage of diapers in America on the pro-life movement. Are you kidding me? _Make more diapers! Don’t kill more babies!!_

Well, I want to give them so much more to be mad about.

We’re engaged in several battles as I write to you – _including in Nebraska, Kansas, Indiana, South Carolina, and New Hampshire_ – but it’s not just legislation we have to worry about.

Radical pro-abortion state referendums are increasingly becoming a threat even to states with pro-life protections already in place.

Pro-Life Friend, these referendums are intentionally written with ambiguous language to confuse voters and allow legislators to define them in a way that permits abortions throughout all nine months of a pregnancy and forces taxpayers to pay for abortions.

In 2024, I’ve gotten word that the Abortion Lobby is trying to force referendums in several states including Maryland, New York, and even Florida!

And Pennsylvania and Virginia are being eyed by the Abortion Lobby for radical referendums down the line if upcoming legislative elections go their way.

If you think we should ease up on our fight against the Abortion Lobby at the state level, including our fight against radical abortion referendums, then mark: **“STOP FIGHTING STATE BATTLES”** on your _Supporter Ballot._

**[STOP FIGHTING STATE BATTLES >>](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdiuuht-duchtdja-j/)**
**3. _Vote Pro-life First_**

One thing we found out in the wake of Ohio’s abortion referendum passing was very shocking: _30% of people surveyed who voted FOR Ohio’s pro-abortion referendum stated that they believe that Life begins at conception._

**What could cause such a thing to happen?**

Well, there are two main reasons that a self-proclaimed pro-lifer would vote for a radical abortion referendum:
*** As I said before, these referendums are intentionally written with ambiguous language to confuse voters; and

*** _Not all pro-lifers vote pro-life first_.
That’s why our _Vote Pro-Life First Campaign_ is designed to eliminate this problem and convince pro-lifers that ending the violence of abortion should be their #1 priority when it comes time to cast their vote.

In years past, we’ve had tremendous success helping pro-abortion Democrat politicians and cowardly Republicans “retire early” by getting voters in their districts to pledge to vote pro-life first and oust anyone who doesn’t stand for Life!

And in 2022, we engaged to ensure pro-life U.S. Congressman Ted Budd won his U.S. Senate race in North Carolina. We launched an all-out targeted digital advertising campaign toward half a million youth voters aimed at eliciting direct pledges to “Vote Pro Life First.” We showed this audience 8-10 tested, messaging ads each & chased their replies. By election day, we had 42,000 pledges to vote pro-life first.

When the smoke cleared, Senator Budd won by just 3.2%, a 121,000 vote margin. On a shoestring budget, the 42,000 pledges we garnered because of your support covered over 1/3 of the spread in this key U.S. Senate race. At a cost of just $1.13 per vote.

This program must be central to our efforts to elect pro-lifer leaders across the board in 2024, but the one thing I need to make this a success is pressure.

But, I can’t put pressure on politicians without grassroots support.

_And I can’t gain grassroots support without the necessary resources to travel to battle districts, knock on doors, send texts, make calls, and host Lobby Days._

Though, if you want me to dial it back and let the pro-abortion politicians remain in office just give me the word by marking: **“STOP YOUR VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST CAMPAIGN”** on your _Supporter Ballot._

**[STOP YOUR VOTE PRO-LIFE FIRST CAMPAIGN >>](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdiuuht-duchtdja-i/)**
**4. _DON’T CUT ANY PROGRAMS_!**

There is one way for me to run all our life-saving programs at full-steam this year and put us in a strong position heading into the 2024 elections: _I fund all of it!_

**But that’s a big ask, Pro-Life Friend.**

I’ll have a difficult enough time funding one or two of these programs, let alone ALL of them!

I want nothing more than to keep my foot on the gas all the way through election day this November, but I won’t be able to do that without the generosity of good folks like you.

If you truly don’t want to see any cuts made, then mark: **“RAMP UP ALL OPERATIONS. Hello Friend,Many of us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. But have you ever wondered where these amazing stories took place?_ _ In our fast-paced society, the average American travels about 30 miles a day. As a result, it can be hard to picture the ministry of Christ as he walked from town to town and village to village healing the sick, raising the dead, and giving sight to the blind.Jesus didn’t zoom around on the expressway, he walked an average of about three miles-per-hour, slow enough to minister to everyone His father put in His path.To help you better understand Jesus’ area of ministry and the world-altering impact it had, I created The Jesus Map. It traces the life and ministry of Jesus Christ, including 52 key events from His birth in Bethlehem to His ascension on the Mount of OlivesThis unique reference tool will let you see where he fed the 5,000, walked on water, and was tempted by Satan. As you walk with Christ and the Apostles down those dusty Israeli roads, you will better understand the questions people asked Him and the needs he confronted.

body:
I've always been fascinated by the story of the earliest Christians.

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/I-_YbzhP8MCelozdqND1gA~~/AARclAA~)
---
| |
Dear Friend,

I've always been fascinated by the story of the earliest Christians.

I wanted to learn more about how they worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it was daunting to figure out how to proceed. I always got lost in foreign names and locations and the complicated history of Imperial Rome. The result was a large gap in my understanding of how the Christian faith took shape and spread from the apostles through the age of Constantine.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, ["Ancient Christianity,"](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/I-_YbzhP8MCelozdqND1gA~~/AARclAA~) now available on DVD.
---
| | In this course, Professor Kenneth Calvert is your guide through the first four centuries of Christianity as he explains the remarkable ways the new faith transformed the Roman world. Would you help support this course so we can make it available to millions of Americans for free? ## Alabama Executes 1st in U.S. by Nitrogen
Alabama has carried out the [nation's first execution by nitrogen ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGSmzAQgOGngW4ZsZIRKSjS0DltSmZBCygjJI-0tuy3z9zVV__NP9_f-3InH3w8_tDFk-xpoU38i5cecAA0i2ndtDMj65an3qoB7ahxaM9JsXU7mW3A0ahVb6MaCTe9OtK_Vou29RMqNKrHoVe3m-k7bTUbVFaTtuz02BjFzkvK3b_ko5y8h096ce62dLVhOkUepdG_G5wbnGut3Z7ekWv56g3Oz9LgTIFWuggck5yQUwUfLxIGfvP2FHYQveR0cISDCkQSn2KB3eciELnCxXImBwbhw5RLmyf3qD4EXwbbGHVc5MP3kPzI8z8AAP__U3RosA)asphyxiation. Pay-for-hire murderer Kenneth Smith stabbed a preacher's wife to death in 1988. The state tried to execute him once through lethal injection, which failed. This time, it used the novel method of death by nitrogen hypoxia. The courts rejected Smith's lawyers' appeals, which were based on the idea that the nitrogen process is so unknown that it [constitutes cruel and unusual punishment.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ_GdIvstcH8BcV_BUpzaVMiAws4wvbJ3juSt49InWaa0Yw-fR_38e784eP27gL1vKbRzexfNCrAFtCMplr6lQhJV9QrK1u0nca22nvULWotsSFsVGdn2zXrNCvq_lk7dZOpfI8SjVTYKtk0RtXaajIorXba0qI7YSQtnlOuP5OPvNN6fKcX5XpOoTr6nflRhP4vcBA4nOdZhxKvTuBAEbZJ4BDpLAKH5xXucJMLDgoxcAL6ovnJBD4GxwSn5x2i55y2a-wKOIj0ogwTrSkTPAstEIj3tFxnGW43tZN5c1Xul8fpj8OX1gojt-D88cvIfxr7CQAA__-myGyr) The state says it should cause relatively "painless" death within minutes.
## Tallest Skyscraper Proposed for Oklahoma
The nation's [tallest skyscraper ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2S2yAUQOGnQR0auGBhFxRp1DltSg0_F-smGDQCWfbbZ3br7U9x5vtzX-6OMpXHb_dE21NdXOj0wkVymDjoRQ_RJkRANaCVRkxgrgqmYbXowUQpU_DyFr0LUnnvk7uBCRKvFxjIggAtJExSXC5ajsoo1CCMcspgVFemBUbqdR__Vip9xZQ_9YX7GOpzyHbtfWtM_WIwM5jP8xxTffujUcHWvhoGc6pvXvBs_GgM5ogvzHXDnW_Uw4qNb9mVxrvLGVvn_qAcqTz40fhRMv3D_OGB-mfYbdxOypnaZJgWj6ej_L3Rf0T5HwAA__897ma3)could be built in Oklahoma City if officials approve plans to increase the tower's proposed height from 1,750 feet to a record 1,907 feet. At that height, the Oklahoma tower would be the fifth tallest building in the world and the highest in America, taller than the current record-holder, One World Trade Center in New York City. body:
Have you seen our previous email?

It may come as no surprise that Washington Democrats have introduced alarming new bills, including House Bill 2030, which would allow felons - even Green River Killer Gary Ridgeway - to vote, and House Bill 2001, which reduces sentences for felons.

And earlier this week, Democrats passed House Bill 1589 in their push to ban natural gas, directly impacting our daily lives.

Now is the time to act - comment against these bills here: [HB2030](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729739:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r), [HB1589](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729740:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r), and [HB2001](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729741:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r). The first legislative deadline is approaching on January 31st, and we need your support to ensure that bills like these are stopped.

We here at Shift WA work hard to expose Democrats' out-of-touch policies. [**Support our work by donating today. Every contribution matters.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729742:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r)

Thank you,

The Shift WA Team
Washington Democrats have crossed a line that we cannot ignore. In a shocking move, Washington Democrats introduced House Bill 2030, which would grant felons in prison - including notorious serial killer Gary Ridgway - the right to vote and serve on a jury. We are not making this up - the bill's Far-Left sponsor admitted her criminals-first approach would extend even to the Green River Killer. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729743:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r "Shift Washington")

|
Friends, Washington Democrats have crossed a line that we cannot ignore. In a shocking move, Washington Democrats introduced [House Bill 2030](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729744:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r), which would grant felons in prison - including notorious serial killer Gary Ridgway - the right to vote and serve on a jury. We are not making this up - the bill's Far-Left sponsor admitted her criminals-first approach would extend even to the Green River Killer. And this is just one of the many outrageous and out-of-touch bills Democrat legislators have brought forward in the first month of the 2024 legislative session. This week, State House Democrats passed [House Bill 1589](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729745:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r) as their next step in banning natural gas in our state. If this bill passes the Senate, it would prohibit gas companies, particularly Puget Sound Energy (PSE), from connecting new natural gas lines to new construction. PSE would also no longer be obligated to provide natural gas service to existing customers. This is an unprecedented intrusion into our everyday lives. But perhaps most egregiously, Democrats seem to have adopted a mantra during this legislative session - "If you can't let them vote, then just let them out." Since their goal of allowing serial killers to vote may be slipping away, they've also introduced [House Bill 2001](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729746:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r), which would mean sentence reductions for current prisoners, by ignoring previous criminal activity that liberals no longer consider criminal. It's not too late to voice your opposition to these bills. The first legislative deadline is approaching on January 31st, and your support can help ensure that bills like these are stopped. You can voice your opposition by officially commenting against these bills here: [HB2030](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729739:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r), [HB1589](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729740:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r), and [HB2001](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729741:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r). Shift WA is the only online outlet you can trust to bring you the latest news from Olympia, exposing Democrats for their terrible policies. We are committed to keeping you informed and empowered. To continue our efforts, we need your support. [**Please consider making a donation today. Every contribution helps us fight against these outrageous bills and hold our elected officials accountable.**](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729742:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r) Thank you, The Shift WA Team P.S. Your donation is crucial in the fight against these out-of-touch bills. [Please contribute today to support our cause.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729742:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r) | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62729747:WAFr2vimN:m:1:2610672541:AAB88D382D8176C292D554F01FF9CA23:r)

| | **Frontline is proud to announce the inaugural Run2Win Conference, set to take place on April 26-27, 2024, at the Hilton Atlanta. ** This isn't just any conference; this event marks a defining moment for conservatives, particularly as the nation's eyes turn towards Georgia in this critical election year. Run2Win will be a dynamic forum to bring together thought leaders, build a powerful movement, and foster a commitment to a winning and transformative message with long-lasting impact. Inspired by 1 Corinthians 9:24, the conference will explore what it truly means to ‘run to win’ as conservatives – in culture, in policy, and for Christ. **[Click here to register now for this impactful gathering. We are offering an early-bird discount for a limited time, so reserve your spot today! ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/fdae7fd2c765cf5bc3d6b838967d376c/44483)** Our nation is at a crossroads, and Georgia stands at the forefront of this cultural and political battle. Run2Win is our response to this challenge – a space to cultivate a movement that wins not only at the ballot box but also in the hearts and minds across our nation. **Event Details:**
* **Dates** : April 26-27, 2024
* **Location** : [Hilton Atlanta](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/ea8a6acd49531eabc3d6b838967d376c/44483)
* **What to Expect:** A conference ticket includes two-day entry for the Main Sessions of the Conference. This will include General Sessions with exciting speakers, Breakout Sessions diving in on specific topics, and Lunch on both days. Run2Win focuses on biblical principles, building a movement, and winning in both the short and long term with strategies that look forward and make a positive impact. *_Breakfast and Dinner tickets will be sold separately at a later date._
* **Registration** : [Open now](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/34399997621f60c9c3d6b838967d376c/44483) with an early-bird discounted rate for a limited time.
---
We've teamed up with leading conservative minds (that we can’t wait to announce soon) to create a conference that is both inspiring and practical, providing you with the tools and strategies needed to make a real impact. We would like to thank our current roster of confirmed sponsors. Victory Partners for the event include [Patriot Mobile](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/f05a5b55be62e2e5c3d6b838967d376c/44483), [The Heritage Foundation](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/ddf7977bb37f05f9c3d6b838967d376c/44483), and [Greater Georgia](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/875bd685f5ac7155c3d6b838967d376c/44483). Strategic Partners for the event include [American Principles Project](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/1dcc8f80cff386e4c3d6b838967d376c/44483), [Family Policy Alliance](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/f63ba1364cee8e98c3d6b838967d376c/44483), and [The Erick Erickson Show](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/de9f002ac2729b24dc9f99905c540ea9/44483/620a9d4a8e593d9b3947229f28c3afba/929b8ce4de56d992c3d6b838967d376c/44483)!
**
**To inquire about partnerships, opportunities, or vendor tables for the event for your business, church, or organization, please email Chris Sanchez at [chris@frontlinepolicy.com](mailto:chris@frontlinepolicy.com "chris@frontlinepolicy.com"). For more information and to register for the Run2Win Conference, please click here. I look forward to welcoming you to Run2Win, where together, we will define the path forward for conservative thought and action.
For His Glory,

Joe Biden said, _“We gotta do something. They ought to give me the money I need to protect the border.”_

We can’t let them get away with it. It is a massive lie and will only make the catastrophe we are facing on the southern border worse. The border catastrophe has gotten so bad that we have had upwards of 10,000 illegal immigrants cross the border illegally in one single day. And that happened for months on end! Every day, we had north of 10,000 illegal immigrants pouring into our country. It is entirely unsustainable and a massive security crisis the likes of which America has never seen on domestic soil. clean_body: It’s not about the money. It's about policy. Joe Biden’s immigration policy is failing our country, and we need to change policies to get the catastrophe under control.| | | Peter - The Democrats are trying to play politics with the border. They are trying to lay blame at Republicans’ feet for the Biden Administration’s complete failure to secure our southern border and stop the flow of fentanyl into America. Joe Biden said, “We gotta do something. They ought to give me the money I need to protect the border.” The crisis at the border is not occurring because of some lack of funding; the situation is happening because of massive policy failures by the Biden administration and a refusal to take on illegal immigration for the scourge it is. We can’t let them get away with it. It is a massive lie and will only make the catastrophe we are facing on the southern border worse. The border catastrophe has gotten so bad that we have had upwards of 10,000 illegal immigrants cross the border illegally in one single day. And that happened for months on end! Every day, we had north of 10,000 illegal immigrants pouring into our country. It is entirely unsustainable and a massive security crisis the likes of which America has never seen on domestic soil. But we can hold Joe Biden accountable and demand action on the border to curtail illegal immigration and secure the border to prevent future illegal immigrants from entering our country. But none of that will happen if we let the Democrats get away with blaming us for the catastrophe by claiming sending $14 billion more to the border will solve the problem. We’ve already sent billions down there and only have failure to show for it. Why should we send more? We need to hold Joe Biden accountable and REFUSE to give the Democrats their $14 billion border boondoggle. Thomas G. West, professor of politics at Hillsdale College, is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding.

That's why we're so excited to offer a course that explains his core teachings about the American Founding, **which is now available on DVD.**

In this course, Dr. West sits down with David Azerrad, his former student and current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government, to reveal the truth about the American Founding. | **
### What students are saying
** “I appreciate the brevity of explanation and new information in a way I hadn't known or realized myself. The quizzes are helpful. Having two teachers converse brings an interesting perspective.” **- Darlena** “It helps put into context the thinking of our founders at that time. That’s very important and misunderstood by so many people today!” **- Robert**
---|---

As Dr. West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to Americans today--even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics--that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and long-forgotten pit."

This course goes about this task by examining the actual words and actions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting and often surprising account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

As you know, our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

And now, for any donation of $100 or more, you will receive this beautiful DVD box set for **" The Real American Founding: A Conversation,"** by clicking the link below.

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/real-american-founding-dvd](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5637576113ef4c02be40f142f7f78c1c&_e=Zl4nC9qGbmG7RRump26AxhYOm0NXTVQ8Kzo1eWTyFZdRIdRzReLV7m8ljMGDpmx5U3iKJd0_QMLuV-Olob68puUk0K5FRqLvpP1sFJ8PPiXc6xNrCUzb1XAkAofRcXeF7iXNmb57NlRcNizVrcIaC5vt6EFKfjF9-vkgRNcpVjiLTq_7GqgI1I4-48dqKs_najS1Ez3GoGTWmoldcPBjTXJWFSczNgnSCUqL7EqJleTj2_QRG-q_uCZ3CJoQ3HA8ZRV25w20xWZOoUofxF_YkLtTllWuBmdS00eYE3XjBZBFBgQupCEn-44GoA_KuCGQqxv3Mc-YAusGcUS7ji44PUk8o_C71MW1uDaWPKkDqkW15pzUKRN_IvGgFVSsWzJwL7IjRmf2wHfqqXDHR7fb1X0OZmX8no6mXsUCIT49ZbAHJi9aR8RFWkOqyIv8QGtg)

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09

subject: Uncover the Fascinating History of Christianity
body:
I've always been fascinated by the story of the earliest Christians.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=da5af91502d6498ab2f8de89f48ca84b&_e=hB9rDmgXoTOGPnWD-0jCaqozhOjVTbcii5XCF9xARM8OVROWELnvYMrEnEwdh6AjsruX76IehgZUG5IbecS7QF2qyXDFBkhUHn9YGRDyDSbnikaoFps3fmwwOIhtL_8k8WVJOCVA_SCTy-1VEu5BCSNiCI4t60LeGeC3T52C4VspUh3apVVm9pcjQ3-MrXjSwQExSRQeV8MmrY9_idG4NSF61dvQDGRUNQQmXbfaARr8-a0GctTFgg4rBFaHxT89I6sJXmPQmJMXhyj38HnBCd4v504lea8kOsk3LQtKCGN0nPwhxr8okWfpfCVLMiSG3fwSdtOAhOI_4Gd6qf16t4-QqFpfj9EOvbjOnQzrE0jewayjgZ25V2z9a5YIvh79okNwc6QRgqLyGvGi_HbRIRND0IoI7BZ0aouRdtGSKyU%3D)

Dear Friend,

I've always been fascinated by the story of the earliest Christians.

I wanted to learn more about how they worshipped and prayed, faced persecution and hardship, and settled theological disputes.

But, beyond reading the New Testament and some of the stories of early Christian martyrs, it was daunting to figure out how to proceed. I always got lost in foreign names and locations and the complicated history of Imperial Rome. The result was a large gap in my understanding of how the Christian faith took shape and spread from the apostles through the age of Constantine.

To uncover this fascinating history, we've produced our online course, ["Ancient Christianity,"](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=da5af91502d6498ab2f8de89f48ca84b&_e=hB9rDmgXoTOGPnWD-0jCaqozhOjVTbcii5XCF9xARM8OVROWELnvYMrEnEwdh6AjsruX76IehgZUG5IbecS7QF2qyXDFBkhUHn9YGRDyDSbnikaoFps3fmwwOIhtL_8k8WVJOCVA_SCTy-1VEu5BCSNiCI4t60LeGeC3T52C4VspUh3apVVm9pcjQ3-MrXjSwQExSRQeV8MmrY9_idG4NSF61dvQDGRUNQQmXbfaARr8-a0GctTFgg4rBFaHxT89I6sJXmPQmJMXhyj38HnBCUbePLPPhUdAuw3Yo275Jvahae0xSY7llM_TYNWsNosTO_a1a1PySwS367otN0cplrg_-AqHc76IaBwqMrLD9U6aGskpMZuaqvka6lK3fo355mcIXMhA3P8uOkUIaW15kvpmC1C0rW7qpqHxDfc6kec%3D) now available on DVD.

subject: How to defend the Constitution

You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=885a2f947cd8497986f1aea3cb0eb36f&_e=emB3Yz2DEVcLOp0gv98dke_VN9cZpT1MEps-kb_Vc0f59jSF31M1wO-VDeO0uHYBy4zfXDvdhppamKo80M3-_B-kGAZ-bhiSRagGObYcKn1Uj2M9zJQ_T5qIp13pR2-49lcsDZNlkLYieVR2OSz4ggAXSp3_Hbmd7cfpoWYwl6n_gfDekmho349c5fPFzzgoCgxeNv_cydj_jM4MicMhOQMmsdo4etB6ZAtBI8llnmP5YZgbtUbFN2I1VhfmM5VuTFKX5x8R6RilCjsbJrphJX68L8CHKRYFHJPacQDSkAlHwtfzMmQWZ3oCyD9AWZVXMLj4zLAJ8Z35Zzm084UUR2WWp3rGADBYQJh3TtxH_pjebE8pMotbrz62rmFwJnD29IfpBPhsD8H4IRXkrhXvxCjSOoyoEYzI4IEstv6PAAY%3D)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. You’ve likely seen how “progressives” in the media, Big Tech, and politics are amplifying attacks on our nation’s principles of limited government and personal liberty with outrageous statements like “The Constitution is kind of trash.” And like that television pundit I mentioned, they are pushing a narrative that our Constitution is **flawed** , **outdated** , and **incapable** of dealing with the challenges of our time. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.
---
| | Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described them as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” And these documents are just as relevant today as they were back then. If we’re serious about solving the current issues in our country, we shouldn’t run from them. We should embrace them. **That’s why I want to send you our entire 10-lesson course,["_The Federalist Papers_ ,"](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=885a2f947cd8497986f1aea3cb0eb36f&_e=emB3Yz2DEVcLOp0gv98dke_VN9cZpT1MEps-kb_Vc0f59jSF31M1wO-VDeO0uHYBy4zfXDvdhppamKo80M3-_B-kGAZ-bhiSRagGObYcKn1Uj2M9zJQ_T5qIp13pR2-49lcsDZNlkLYieVR2OSz4ggAXSp3_Hbmd7cfpoWYwl6n_gfDekmho349c5fPFzzgoCgxeNv_cydj_jM4MicMhOQMmsdo4etB6ZAtBI8llnmP5YZgbtUbFN2I1VhfmM5VuTFKX5x8R6RilCjsbJrphJbqY5dnUNJuApNGbdkazxvPqH4jDxuJYMhOa0HbnwjWU1Vbh9wXxA0EBNc7-TfY0cmK5ln30OMzBbbhLSyjJz4l3P_WfwH5WSoiSow5BwwAPzMrvvycD_MmAEn-R6IGcQbhXsie7o7kxuIQXWKK9hgY%3D)****on DVD today when you make a tax-deductible donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**

| | Dear Fellow American, “The Constitution is kind of trash.” That’s what a guest—with an Ivy League degree—said recently on a highly-rated daytime talk show. Thankfully, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—gave you and me the perfect guide to understanding its timeless principles: _The Federalist Papers_.

Peter, there are some things you need to know about my opponent, Marsha Blackburn. MAGA Marsha was first elected to the House of Representatives back in 2002, then the Senate in 2018. In her two decades in Washington, she’s been the key sponsor of just _15_ pieces of legislation that became law — and since the fall of 2021, the only thing she’s gotten done is naming a few post offices. My opponent spends **A LOT** of time on FOX News talking about culture war issues, and far too little solving the real issues facing Tennessee. Meanwhile, one in eight kids in our state faces hunger. Our public school funding ranks among the lowest in the nation and we’re in a child care crisis. What does Marsha Blackburn do about it? _She just keeps talking on FOX_ — railing against the real solutions put forth by Democratic leaders. Tennesseans can see that Marsha’s not in Washington to work for us. She’s there to parrot partisan talking points and provide a vote for her special-interest donors. **It’s no wonder that Marsha’s now among the LEAST popular U.S. Senators, Peter.** When I’m in the Senate, I won’t waste time delivering soundbites for cable. I’m not in this job for optics. **I’m running to deliver results.** For the families torn apart by gun violence, I’ll fight for commonsense reforms. For women seeking reproductive autonomy, I’ll fight to enshrine it in federal law. | | Dear Friend,

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zte96mte77peh5l5ko5vtj8nl1nsaa0q1m7msm90_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9ie4o31cjh2bs) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of midcentury liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to understand the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Dear Peter,
Our outrage that the Canadian Supreme Court would force psychiatrist Jordan Peterson to undergo “social media training” for “demeaning posts”— __or lose his medical license__ —did not go unnoticed.
Even the popular Dr. Peterson himself thanked our campaign for highlighting his plight on his X account (formerly known as Twitter).
The fact is, we live in a country that was built upon the principles of freedom—spelled out in our Bill of Rights, the first 10 Amendments of our Constitution.
The First Amendment says in no uncertain terms: Congress shall make no law “abridging the freedom of speech.”
And while Canada does not share our Constitution, they have long held to the principles found therein.
Several media outlets were as shocked as we were that someone like Dr. Peterson could be forced to undergo training or lose his job.
One news headline read:
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=censor_1_26_24_email_1rs_1_nd&n=2)
The article noted:
| A U.S. presidential candidate and a U.S. congressman have condemned recent Canadian court rulings that allow the College of Psychologists of Ontario (CPO) to require Jordan Peterson to undergo social media training in order to keep his professional licence.
---
Dr. Peterson, in a Jan. 20 post on X, shared a letter sent by Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s office to a recipient named "Norman" that noted similarities between Dr. Peterson's case and Mr. Kennedy's campaign, which the letter said is "currently facing mainstream media censorship."
"The breaking news that a Canadian Court is forcing psychiatrist Jordan Peterson to undergo state-sanctioned media training because of 'demeaning' social media posts is an assault to the fundamental tenets of Democracy and Freedom," said the letter, emailed to Mr. Kennedy's campaign supporters on Jan. 20, as confirmed by his press secretary, Stefanie Spear.
Mr. Kennedy, a former Democrat, had initially challenged U.S. President Joe Biden for the Democratic nomination. In October 2023, he announced he would run for president as an independent instead. The letter, which seeks additional support for his campaign, condemns authoritarianism while making reference to Dr. Peterson's case.
"That a Canadian court would force anyone to submit to their speech codes or else lose his or her ability to earn a living more resembles Communist-led China, not a free nation," it said.
"Authoritarianism was tried by many nations in the 20th century, and it failed every single time because people of the free world opposed those regimes that sought to terminate fundamental human rights."
###
Our nation has led the free nations of the world in protecting and promoting human rights. The United States has long served as a light for the world to emulate, and we have a long standing agreement with our Canadian friends on this critical issue.
Yet in today’s age, there are many—even in our own country—who are calling for more and more censorship.
According to one recent [poll](https://www.kennedy24.com/r?u=954wJVfXJnGDSMt_j90vIsrjhRXLT-nmcgjtW0sV489AefUIk-qAWJwKUxFmyMSZAb-2M8mFMJrGNZrtx2nMKrBq4AbHgcKJdaqrXIDPveiUedE0U2Uj2eQpqr_vWhpf8QwadpwaPPHSvAzDoj_xIg&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=censor_1_26_24_email_1rs_1_nd&n=3) in which respondents were asked if they agree or disagree with the statement “I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it”, only 31% of Democratic voters “strongly agreed” and only 34% of Independents agreed with the sentiment.
For the record, our campaign believes in the basic and universal right to speech without qualification.
As a people, we need to be able to disagree with one another and offer differing viewpoints without fear of retribution.
Watch Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.’s video HELP ME STOP THE CENSORSHIP [here](https://www.kennedy24.com/help-stop-censorship-video?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=censor_1_26_24_email_1rs_1_nd&n=4).

| | Dear Friend,

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zohi75hdv1g76567b69uu186ni99kmk76hr9qss0_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9ie4o36cjh2bs) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of midcentury liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to understand the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left
body:
In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

| | | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgk9ln3sm8qi8lkrigek9btr3kiiul76nllpbfko_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9ie4o31cjh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqerhmju5mh9f9hbsvm0ng2pbda0m398g2bhouug_rp22sh2s8i6eo33c9ie4o31cjh2bs) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of midcentury liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to understand the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

**Click the link below to help support this course and get your copy of "The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism" on DVD.**

body:
Asked whether we're on the cusp of a US Dollar crash, Dave Ramsey made a stunning miscalculation while live on air:

Blackrock warns "Prepare for a recession unlike any other." Central banks igniting a global recession with their fight to stop inflation.
| | | |
---|---|---
---
# Dave Ramsey Is Dangerously Wrong
# And Here's Why>>

---
Asked whether we're on the cusp of a US Dollar crash, Dave Ramsey made a stunning miscalculation while live on air:

"Am I worried about this? Absolutely not."

Frankly, I've never seen someone so confident in being wrong...

Because what's happening to the US Dollar is not something you should "keep an eye on"...

But instead, is an imminent threat you should get ahead of right NOW.

See, China, Brazil, India, and Russia have finally teamed up to create 1 common currency...

And they're now joined by the oil-producing giants of the Middle East, and dozens of other countries.

This means it will be the greenback against 1 single currency for the rest of the world.

And let me tell you, that's a showdown we might not win.

| | In a recent and exclusive column in the Sun, I wrote:

# **A Message from the Chairwoman****
---
| | ** _The Filing Deadline is Only Two Weeks Away!_**_**
---
Friends, We are only TWO WEEKS away from the filing deadline to be on the primary election ballot for the all-important 2024 elections. It is crucial for the continued growth of our party that Republicans in all 92 counties make the time to file for precinct committeeman and state delegate. We continue to emphasize the importance of these roles because they are the grassroots foundation of our party. And when it comes to party building, there is nothing more important than our grassroots. We encourage all Republicans who are interested in building our party to new levels of success to file for these positions as soon as possible. A strong party requires precinct committeemen and state delegates that lead us at the local level. Time is of the essence, so please don't wait! Be sure to file your [CAN-37 form ](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b44a9a0d5bff271a3947229f28c3afba/0399848e54b71574c3d6b838967d376c/40313)before it's too late. Together, we will continue to build our party. Thank you for all that you do.
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway

# Republican Lawmakers Are Taking On Reading Proficiency

---
---
| | This year, Republican lawmakers are focused on improving reading proficiency throughout the state. **What to know and why it's important:****
* Many experts agree that it is crucial to a student’s future success that they can read by the end of grade 3. Students who are not proficient readers by this time are likely to experience ongoing struggles throughout their education.
* Indiana’s reading proficiency scores have dropped by almost 10% over the last decade, from 91.4% in 2013 to 81.9% in 2023.

** Some Proposed Legislative Solutions as of 1/26 ****
* [SB 1: Reading Skills](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b44a9a0d5bff271a3947229f28c3afba/aaf7f16110a0b8ecc3d6b838967d376c/40313)
* Science of Reading Instruction.
* Early Detection & Remediation.
* LAST RESORT retaining those students who failed IREAD-3 for the third time.

* [SB 6: Reading Proficiency](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/b44a9a0d5bff271a3947229f28c3afba/19eda9e083c43d16c3d6b838967d376c/40313)
* Companion bill to SB 1.
* Requires the department of education to develop a method to identify students in grade 4 through 8 who did not pass the determinant evaluation of reading skills approved by the state board and develop guidance for schools regarding how to support those students at risk of not being proficient in reading.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os7JvKviJN

Hello
Friend,
Many of
us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. But
have you ever wondered where these amazing stories took place?
In our
fast-paced society, the average American travels about 30 miles a
day. As a result, it can be hard to picture the ministry of
Christ as he walked from town to town and village to village
healing the sick, raising the dead, and giving sight to the
blind.
Jesus
didn't zoom around on the expressway, he walked an average of
about three miles-per-hour, slow enough to minister to everyone
His father put in His path.
To help
you better understand Jesus' area of ministry and the
world-altering impact it had, I created The Jesus Map. It traces
the life and ministry of Jesus Christ, including 52 key events
from His birth in Bethlehem to His ascension on the Mount of
Olives
This
unique reference tool will let you see where he fed the 5,000,
walked on water, and was tempted by Satan. As you walk with
Christ and the Apostles down those dusty Israeli roads, you will
better understand the questions people asked Him and the needs he
confronted.

I pray it
will also inspire you with ways God wants to use you in your area
of influence. Many times, we only need to slow down enough to see
what God has in mind.
Here's
your link to get the map and begin your journey of discovery:
https://ptv.org/nna/the-jesus-map
Let's
walk together along the path of Jesus Christ.

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas
