| | Fellow American, **[**Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?**](http://links.conservativetribune.co/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2f050d98547f47509cb027a79642a000&_e=mWDFdAlnzv6TyNaH4zAC5TseCDBG1kRx75cbOTQx854GNkFS7H8CbVigW_gKFGYSvBs9TNJwPRpPxEw9xu3WMGxCd0txMHJO6_uzcpq2v63jMAHM77zPzCyT6X1F9UVDjkH0fzs0F4J7lARIAp4MEex2Z04kKJVvhT2z3irKZ33emCCaLOKrT7O6E0bOyel_XgOnNJEVedsHI4nW1qIJLdCJ25EaPCWwGykzsWZdCBoKrmzS17wOnbwpQEticvonn6cOuc5NFJ-CgzTsMneXWFsIu00zkmB4wcsG2Y5orzv--aBhO2P12QeeNV3PSqFyPNo3BHbEMc7m6hEH25jsIQMQ9X6HvJuAJC3oMqaZ-tAmXncLiuitAkkmciQV5Nf7WNDMvG4mRJBlbgnBy_KLiQ%3D%3D)** That's the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November. I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to "choose" between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee... ...and that's being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go "three up...three down" against this lineup of liberal career politicians. That's a bit of baseball vernacular. No surprise, right? It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning. Then, it's your team's turn to go on offense. Well, that's very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country. Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years - most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I'm reaching out to you today. **[Will you step up and help strike out this"lineup of liberals" through a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today?](http://links.conservativetribune.co/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2f050d98547f47509cb027a79642a000&_e=mWDFdAlnzv6TyNaH4zAC5TseCDBG1kRx75cbOTQx854GNkFS7H8CbVigW_gKFGYSvBs9TNJwPRpPxEw9xu3WMGxCd0txMHJO6_uzcpq2v63jMAHM77zPzCyT6X1F9UVDjkH0fzs0F4J7lARIAp4MEex2Z04kKJVvhT2z3irKZ33emCCaLOKrT7O6E0bOyel_XgOnNJEVedsHI4nW1qIJLdCJ25EaPCWwGykzsWZdCBo8n9gxaD6oHlFVbXK3OkdzdC8_kB0oaAndCUeIqiqDerhF_tdCkcGM8mtQf6KYFExqykc6ufpHcHsExB9p2e2QxxZbHBY5fEeTYJKbayFWRgA0Fz-KcS_AwmFd6A1RU7q77jJp6bAaCZfv4t5FjCwrpIDBMCoQA-xP1cWovfCflQ%3D%3D)** Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California. Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California. • Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don't lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---
If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a "false choice" between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, **[**then I need you to take immediate action and rush a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today.**](http://links.conservativetribune.co/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2f050d98547f47509cb027a79642a000&_e=mWDFdAlnzv6TyNaH4zAC5TseCDBG1kRx75cbOTQx854GNkFS7H8CbVigW_gKFGYSvBs9TNJwPRpPxEw9xu3WMGxCd0txMHJO6_uzcpq2v63jMAHM77zPzCyT6X1F9UVDjkH0fzs0F4J7lARIAp4MEex2Z04kKJVvhT2z3irKZ33emCCaLOKrT7O6E0bOyel_XgOnNJEVedsHI4nW1qIJLdCJ25EaPCWwGykzsWZdCBpil04i2Isg6klVY68JfJi_ghRg24p_ZmGr5rUFbWOHeg-3GKNAKiFLKwIonRjmhTsPJJz1n_VZODSxpz1HyUU-UjXUg8-no4S7ESMdw0_UHIS34pvhI5L5HomfdDS2IStR3dhrejEzIRH5EC9GSRibrY_qRH59EchT2SXMac73bA%3D%3D)** Winning this election requires a one-two punch:
---
1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign "connecting the dots" between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.
---
In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That's my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. **[But I need your help. I'd consider it a great honor to have you on my campaign team. I also consider your support a must have in order to win this race.](http://links.conservativetribune.co/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=2f050d98547f47509cb027a79642a000&_e=mWDFdAlnzv6TyNaH4zAC5TseCDBG1kRx75cbOTQx854GNkFS7H8CbVigW_gKFGYSvBs9TNJwPRpPxEw9xu3WMGxCd0txMHJO6_uzcpq2v63jMAHM77zPzCyT6X1F9UVDjkH0fzs0F4J7lARIAp4MEex2Z04kKJVvhT2z3irKZ33emCCaLOKrT7O6E0bOyel_XgOnNJEVedsHI4nW1qIJLdCJ25EaPCWwGykzsWZdCBojQ5w61OSiTu_ou5GkGoEWzOq0_T3W7u9S-flRTEdWUPc8aDHPzXNRMy5F2tfyYhEfiE_4eZxwb1GA5i3U8oWZZKpPjv3hn-wZH3vIe5-mS59nxe3RoBmeRIaQxqeSUWcOgSG7vT3L0HhUNDICbswTnvwtv3YROD4ea1CJZjAL4A%3D%3D)** With you on our side, I'm confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again.
---
| | With deepest appreciation,
---
---
Steve Garvey Republican for United States Senate

**MY VISION**
---
My campaign is focused on quality-of-life issues, public safety, and education. As your U.S. Senator, I will serve with commonsense, compassion, and will work to build consensus to benefit all of the people of California. I've been fortunate to wear many hats in life - from professional athlete to businessman to philanthropist. But the one thing that has remained consistent is my love for this great state and my desire to make a difference. In baseball, it's not about the individual; it's about the team. I believe the same holds true for politics. It's time we come together, find common ground, and work towards a brighter future.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Michigan turns 187 today
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1068%2E135344%2EQssHix)

187 years ago today, Michigan officially became a state and joined the union.
Michigan is the place that made me who I am and is the touchstone for everything that I do. So in honor of our great state, here are some other things that were invented in Michigan: Gerber baby food, breakfast cereal, Vernors – the first ginger ale and, as we all know, the cure for stomach aches – and of course, the middle class.
In 1913, Ford implemented the very first assembly line in Detroit, reducing the time it took to build an automobile from 12 hours to around 90 minutes. About 3 months later, they announced that every worker would make at least $5 per day, doubling daily wages.
This announcement set off a revolution. All of a sudden, there was a class of workers who could afford to buy a home, buy one of the cars they were making, and put away a bit of savings each month. Hundreds of thousands moved to Michigan for the jobs, particularly immigrants and African Americans fleeing the segregated South. The middle class became one of the pillars of American society, and the anchor in a multi-racial, multi-ethnic experiment in democracy.
More than 100 years later, the middle class is under threat. For too many Michiganders, money is tight and home ownership is out of reach. One of the big reasons I’m in this fight is to help more Michiganders get and stay into the middle class: that means lowering costs, raising wages, strengthening our unions, and making more things in America.
We need that anchor – that very American anchor – of the middle class.
Given that, I spend a lot of time on the kitchen table issues that make the middle class work. How do we create more and more jobs? And how can we ensure those jobs pay a living wage and have good benefits? How can we support our small business owners and entrepreneurs who want to contribute something new, and break down barriers and red tape that keep people from starting something new? And how do we go after the exorbitant costs of health care, prescription drugs, childcare, housing, and postsecondary education?
Because in order for the middle class to work, the math has to work for daily life. When people live a stable, middle class life and can provide to their kids more than they had, they are more generous with people around them.
[**I’m on a mission to expand the middle class in the state that invented it, and I hope you’ll join me. So today, in honor of the birthday of the state that invented the middle class, could you chip in a few bucks to show the love?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240126-1-15&t=2&akid=1068%2E135344%2EQssHix)**

| Friend,
This weekend I am wheels up for Las Vegas, NV at the invitation of Turning Point Action for the Restoring National Confidence Summit, followed by the Republican National Committee's Winter Meeting as a guest of Colorado's Republican National Committeeman Randy Corporon.
These two events are critical to learning the ropes of serving as your Committeewoman. The Turning Point Action event will include listening sessions with sitting members of the RNC, meetings with fellow candidates for the RNC, also invited by Turning Point, and training for County Chairs that have been invited from across the country on how to chase the vote, raise funds, and lead victories in their respective counties.
At this event we will also hear from many amazing patriots like Mike Lindell, Scott Pressler, Charlie Kirk, and more!
Following the Restoring National Confidence Summit, I will then move down the street to the Paris Hotel to attend the Republican National Committee's Winter Meeting.
Colorado's National Committeeman Randy Corporon was kind enough to invite me to participate in the meeting as a guest. Attending this meeting will provide a further opportunity to get to know the other members of the National Committee and see how the meetings are conducted so I can be best prepared to serve as your committeewoman if you elect me in April.
Last month I had the honor of attending America Fest in Phoenix, AZ again at the request of Turning Point Action. I have included some photos from the event below:

| While at America Fest, Turning Point Action and the Mount Vernon Project held an RNC Town Hall with current members of the Republican National Committee where they answered questions about the state of the RNC, the Presidential Primary, plans to replace Ronna McDaniel and more.
It was a very informative breakout session as was the "How to become an RNC National Delegate" session. The knowledge gained at America Fest is vast and well worth the time, and investment to attend if you have not before.
As well as traveling to Phoenix and Las Vegas, I have also made stops in 10+ counties in just the past 60 days. Visiting LaPlata, Huerfano, Denver, Boulder, Jefferson, Arapahoe, Douglas, Fremont, Teller, and Custer counties just to name a few. I have also had successful phone conversations and written contact with perspective delegates in all 64 counties.
The grassroots of Colorado are fired up for 2024 and I am confident in our path to victory across the country.
When elected your next Republican National Committeewoman, I will do everything in my power on the National Committee to ensure the RNC does everything it possibly can to ensure victory in 2024.
If visiting these counties and traveling to America Fest showed me anything, it showed me that we have the momentum to win, but that just because we think it is there, does not mean we can sit back and watch. We must be active, we must engage, we must out-spend the democrats, we must vote, and we must dedicate everything in our being to winning these races.

Hi Peter, it’s Jason Kander. I’m the veteran and Democrat who was elected statewide as Missouri’s Secretary of State and then nearly defeated Roy Blunt, an incumbent GOP Senator, in one of the closest races of the 2016 election cycle.
**With Joe Manchin’s retirement taking West Virginia’s Senate race off the board, our Senate race here in Missouri is the perfect candidate to replace it.**
So in a moment, **[I’m going to ask you to join me in supporting Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43131?refcode=em20240126-4683&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4683%2E614464%2EujTOm7)** But first, please let me explain why I know Lucas has what it takes to flip this Senate seat:

---
If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.
**[I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and I hope you’ll join me by adding a donation of $10 or whatever you’re able to today. Multiple polls have already confirmed that this will be a tight race, so your early support could be what helps Lucas tip the scales.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43131?refcode=em20240126-4683&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=4683%2E614464%2EujTOm7)**

**Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable.**
Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.
>From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans.
**Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen.**
Approval polling from _Morning Consult_ shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the _“worst mistake I ever made.”_
Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — _“So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it.** The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race.

Folks, I have not held back when it comes to calling on Postmaster General Louis DeJoy to improve the United States Postal Service. From delayed mail service to poor working conditions for mail carriers in Minnesota, I am deeply concerned about the state of the USPS under Louis DeJoy — and I’m calling on him to answer for these concerns. **[Please join me in demanding Louis DeJoy answer our concerns right away. The USPS is too important to millions of Americans to let service suffer, mail carriers struggle, and mail go un-delivered — especially in an election year.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77784254/451485204/1121753536?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC60_20240126_AM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NmM2NDk1NS02NGJjLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gfA8Xzl5OsqlTZh53lNy3No2S68dkzVz6vDE6hcTmyA=&emci=f2fadf4d-64bc-ee11-b660-002248223197&emdi=76c64955-64bc-ee11-b660-002248223197&ceid=6227932)** | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77784255/451485205/1121753536?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC60_20240126_AM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NmM2NDk1NS02NGJjLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gfA8Xzl5OsqlTZh53lNy3No2S68dkzVz6vDE6hcTmyA=&emci=f2fadf4d-64bc-ee11-b660-002248223197&emdi=76c64955-64bc-ee11-b660-002248223197&ceid=6227932)

The USPS is a vital lifeline for millions of Minnesotans — delivering medicine, Social Security checks, mail-in ballots, and important documents and packages. The mail carriers who provide this service are superheroes, and they deserve to be treated as such.
Last month, I heard from USPS mail carriers in Bemidji and Rochester who are struggling to keep up with the heavy volume of mail.
I’m calling on Louis DeJoy to answer to the difficult working conditions for mail carriers in Minnesota and across the country.
**The American people deserve mail that is delivered on time, and the carriers who provide this service deserve better working conditions.**
**[If you agree, please join me in holding Louis DeJoy accountable for the troubling reports of delayed service and overworked mail carriers.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77784256/451485206/1121753536?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_EG_GEN_PET_AC60_20240126_AM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NmM2NDk1NS02NGJjLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=gfA8Xzl5OsqlTZh53lNy3No2S68dkzVz6vDE6hcTmyA=&emci=f2fadf4d-64bc-ee11-b660-002248223197&emdi=76c64955-64bc-ee11-b660-002248223197&ceid=6227932)**

— Tina

subject: Trump has directed the GOP to block any deal for Ukraine aid
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
This will have a real cost.
#
Derek, it’s Alex Vindman.
Trump has directed the GOP to block any deal for Ukraine aid. He’s doing it to withhold any bipartisan “win” for President Biden. McConnell himself has admitted it. The fact is Trump is helping Putin and many more Ukrainians will die as a result.
The entire Republican party seems like it is the party of the Kremlin.
This goes all the way back to the phone call that changed my life back in 2019, the call that led to Trump’s first impeachment. From the beginning of Trump’s political career, he has used his domination of the Republican party to undermine Ukraine and help Russia. And Trump will attack any member of the House and Senate that defies him.
This will have a real cost.
Without additional aid from the United States, more brave Ukrainians will die. It means missiles raining down on Ukrainian cities and towns. It means an emboldened Russia threatening our allies — and a new lease on life for Putin. He knows he only needs to hold on long enough for Trump to win in November.
That can’t happen.
We must keep pushing to pass aid for Ukraine. It is critical to our own national security. But we have to punish Trump and the GOP for putting our national security on the brink of disaster.
I am more resolved than ever to defeat Trump and every MAGA member of Congress. That’s why I’m working with VoteVets. And that's why I’m writing to you today.

As we gather today to commemorate the 187th birthday of our dear Michigan, I find myself reflecting on the journey we've embarked on together, the challenges we've overcome, and the opportunities that lie ahead.

Friend,
Our state, founded on January 26, 1837, has weathered many storms. From its origins with our Indigenous people, the fur trading industry, the copper boom, and the rise of the automotive industry, we have forever shown pure Michigan grit.
It's that resilience and tenacity I'm eager to bring to Congress.
To take this endeavor forward, I need your support. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] Together, we can ensure the legacy of our state continues onward, forward, and up.
I am biased, but the First Congressional District represents the best of Michigan. It deserves to be protected, nurtured, and cared for.
>From the Eben Ice Caves to Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore, from the cliffs of Pictured Rocks to the wineries of Traverse City, there's always a thrilling adventure to embark upon. Northern Michigan and the UP offer natural beauty, outdoor activities, pristine waters, the toughest small businesses and people on the planet.
As we celebrate Michigan's 187th birthday today, let's not just look back on our state's history, but also look forward to the future we can build together; A future where every Michigander has access to quality healthcare, where our economy thrives on the backbone of small businesses and a reignited labor movement, and where our natural resources are preserved for generations to come.
Thank you for your generosity and loyalty to my journey to Congress and, most importantly, your belief in the potential of Michigan's progress and prosperity.
Happy birthday, Michigan! 187 years never looked so fresh.
-Dr. Bob

Political retribution for exposing Donald Trump’s Russia and Ukraine misconduct and for holding him accountable during his first impeachment trial. Kevin McCarthy backed the censure resolution to appease Trump and his MAGA members in Congress. In fact, Trump threatened to primary any Republican who voted against the resolution. Many Republican members who opposed it, then folded like a tent, and when the time came, the measure passed by a party-line vote.
Unfortunately, it’s clear the GOP still sees me as their biggest threat — because the attacks haven’t stopped. Recently, Trump attacked me in Iowa, now Sean Hannity and Kid Rock are piling on.
**As you can see, these MAGA attacks are getting more and more desperate by the day, Peter.** They know how effective I am, so they are prepared to throw every dirty trick in the book to sabotage my campaign for truth and justice — especially as the election gets closer.

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. | | | | | | Friend, Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>" Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?" | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, "I need your help – starting right now. " Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | - "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility. subject: Sign the petition: Pushing Palestinians out of their homeland is ethnic cleansing.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In a clear example of ethnic cleansing, top Israeli officials are openly
calling to push millions of Palestinians out of Gaza—and advocating for
replacing them with Israeli settlers.

Many Israeli politicians have demanded a “second Nakba,” referring to the
catastrophe of 1948, when Zionist militias violently expelled 750,000
Palestinians from their lands, destroyed hundreds of Palestinian villages,
and massacred about 15,000 Palestinians.

A member of Prime Minister Netanyahu’s cabinet said: “We are now rolling
out the Gaza Nakba.”

Some survivors of 1948’s Nakba fled to Gaza. Along with Palestinians in
exile outside of Palestine, they were denied the right to return home. Now
they and their descendants have become refugees once more, forced to flee
multiple locations in just three months.

Dropping tens of thousands of U.S. bombs on the tiny Gaza Strip, the
Israeli military has already forcibly displaced 2 million Palestinians—90%
of Gaza’s population.

[ https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-now-to-president-biden-stop-the-ethnic-cleansing-of-palestinians-dont-allow-israels-government-to-force-the-palestinian-people-out-of-their-historic-homeland/?source=group-justice-democrats&referrer=group-justice-democrats&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jdem-20240126%3Frefcode%3Dem20240126&akid=33010%2E1203867%2ENmobpF ]Sign the petition to the Biden administration: End this campaign of
ethnic cleansing now. No more forced displacement of Palestinians, and no
forced migration out of Palestine!

[ https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-now-to-president-biden-stop-the-ethnic-cleansing-of-palestinians-dont-allow-israels-government-to-force-the-palestinian-people-out-of-their-historic-homeland/?source=group-justice-democrats&referrer=group-justice-democrats&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jdem-20240126%3Frefcode%3Dem20240126&akid=33010%2E1203867%2ENmobpF ]SIGN THE PETITION

Razing entire neighborhoods to the ground and destroying a majority of
buildings, Israel’s government has rapidly made much of Gaza
uninhabitable.

Meanwhile, the Israeli military continues to bomb areas it designated as
“safe” for Palestinian civilians.

Along with this brutal destruction, Israel’s government is depriving
Palestinians in Gaza of food, water, shelter, medical assistance, and
other basic needs.

What’s happening now is ethnic cleansing, which is a war crime.

But many Israeli politicians want to go even further, openly calling to
permanently expel all Palestinians from Gaza.

Prime Minister Netanyahu’s Intelligence Minister has openly recommended
the transfer of all Palestinians in Gaza to Egypt. Other senior officials
in Netanyahu’s cabinet have made it clear that forced expulsion and
resettlement is their goal.

Netanyahu has been trying to push countries to take displaced
Palestinians, calling his plan “voluntary migration.” Of course, there’s
nothing “voluntary” about bombing people to make them flee.

Biden and leaders in his administration say they reject forced
displacement of Palestinians.

But their actions show otherwise: They are continuing to arm and fund
Israel’s military as it commits these war crimes, while shielding Israel’s
government from accountability.

[ https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-now-to-president-biden-stop-the-ethnic-cleansing-of-palestinians-dont-allow-israels-government-to-force-the-palestinian-people-out-of-their-historic-homeland/?source=group-justice-democrats&referrer=group-justice-democrats&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jdem-20240126%3Frefcode%3Dem20240126&akid=33010%2E1203867%2ENmobpF ]Sign to Biden and leaders in his administration: Don't let Israel’s
government expel Palestinians from their ancestral homeland or move
Israeli settlers into Gaza. Stop supporting ethnic cleansing and war
crimes!

[ https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-now-to-president-biden-stop-the-ethnic-cleansing-of-palestinians-dont-allow-israels-government-to-force-the-palestinian-people-out-of-their-historic-homeland/?source=group-justice-democrats&referrer=group-justice-democrats&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jdem-20240126%3Frefcode%3Dem20240126&akid=33010%2E1203867%2ENmobpF ]SIGN NOW

We cannot allow our government to continue enabling the bombing or the
blockade on Gaza, which has already killed at least 24,000 Palestinians.
That’s more than 1 in every 100 people in Gaza!

Thank you for speaking up against our government’s complicity in
oppression. May we continue building a better world together.

In solidarity,

Rep. Rashida Tlaib

name: David Horowitz
subject: Barack Obama's Revolution
body:
America is on the brink of destruction.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd146j1lisn3ugbdc7smnhnkqbpcleev9p09letg_rp22sh2s8i6eo33cpg62or6c9h2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. body:
Bills That Passed Out of the Senate & Heading to the House
| | | | VIRGINIA GENERAL ASSEMBLY WEEKLY RECAP SENATE
WEEK ENDING 1/26/24
---
---
|
Friends, With several thousand Senate and House bills coming before the General Assembly, it can be overwhelming to try to read and study every bill. You need a strategy.
Having served in the Senate for 8 years, I mainly focus on Senate bills coming before the Senate and worry about House bills coming up after cross over, when I only have to focus on House bills that survived the House.
You can click on the links at the bottom of this newsletter if you want to review House bills.
Know that I will be mainly focused on Senate bills until cross over, which is Tuesday, February 13 at midnight. Both bodies have to complete their own legislation by midnight. At that point, I will shift to House bills.
I've highlighted the top Senate bills that should be of interest to you. Hope this helps those of you trying to follow the decisions that effect your quality of life and will go into effect July 1, 2024.
The Virginia General Assembly is scheduled to adjourn sine die on Saturday, March 9, 2024.
Feel free to reply to this email if you have any questions I can answer for you.

Friends,
No state has faced opposition from its RINO Republican leadership quite like the South Carolina Freedom Caucus (SCFC).
Less than a month into the 2024 session, the attacks have gotten even worse than last year.
The Palmetto State has a "Republican" supermajority in their legislature (88R-36D House, 30R-15D Senate), but an [analysis of their voting records](https://substack.com/redirect/516d0ded-5733-496d-989e-60b42af1aeab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) shows only Republicans in Hawaii have more liberal voting records.
In last year's session, GOP leadership kicked the entire Freedom Caucus out of the SC House Republican Caucus. Why? They [refused](https://substack.com/redirect/212f92b6-08fc-453d-b8ca-37ad71bf5fa6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to sign a pledge to essentially never criticize their fellow Republicans.
This year, they're trying to muzzle the SCFC by shutting down debate.
Led by RINO GOP Majority Leader Davey Hiott, South Carolina Republicans are proposing a new rules package for the House this year that limits the amount of amendments that members can bring forward on any given bill.
Not only that, but it gives the Majority and Minority Leaders sole authority to choose which amendments actually get voted on. So not only are they trying to shut conservatives out of the legislative process entirely, they want to give Democrats the procedural power to help them do it! The same Democrats who technically have zero leverage to have any control in the process.
To put it as simply as we can - RINO Republicans are teaming up with the Democrats to shut down the SC Freedom Caucus by preventing them from offering conservative amendments to their big government bills. In a state where Trump beat Biden by double-digits, this is nothing short of INSANE.
Thankfully, after the SC Freedom Caucus raised the alarm on social media and to the grassroots, leadership was forced to delay a vote on the rules package. But the RINOs will keep trying. This fight isn't over.
Read more about it in this [Fox News](https://substack.com/redirect/7e48a33d-9727-451c-a2c5-d9e3e5aee781?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) piece.
Believe it or not, the RINOs in South Carolina recently did something else that is equally bad, if not worse!
There is currently a judicial vacancy in South Carolina's 5th Circuit Court, and the legislature is in charge of approving nominations for the bench.
Now given the fact that SC has a "Republican supermajority," you'd think their choice would be a rock-ribbed conservative in the mold of Justice Clarence Thomas.
But you couldn't be more wrong.
The leading candidate that RINO Republicans want to put on the bench is a man named James Smith. He was the state's Democrat nominee for Governor in 2018 and the former Democrat Minority Leader in the State House. He's pro-Biden, pro-abortion, and pro-Medicaid expansion.
Yet despite this, Smith has the support from a majority of Republicans in the House for this judicial seat. Why? Because he's part of the "Good Ol' Boys" network. If confirmed, can you imagine the kind of damage he could inflict by "legislating from the bench"?
The SC Freedom Caucus will fight to ensure that his candidacy is terminated. If they can't kill the nomination ahead of time, we anticipate the vote for his confirmation will be held in early February.
"This judicial race highlights exactly why South Carolina desperately needs both a reformed judicial system and more reform-minded, true conservatives in the South Carolina General Assembly," said State Freedom Caucus Network's SC Director Evan Newman.
Read more in the [Daily Signal.](https://substack.com/redirect/da2aeacd-234c-482b-8aab-1ec79a278159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Help us stop this insanity by supporting the State Freedom Caucus Network. When you support us, it means the SC Freedom Caucus and our other states have the resources they need to fight Democrats AND the liberal Republicans who enable them.
Please consider giving [$50, $100, or even $1000](https://substack.com/redirect/b673153f-5dca-4ecf-bd0f-63558b6c0144?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) \- whatever you can afford. Help us help our brave freedom caucus members!
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**

RINOs are trying to silence the SC Freedom Caucus | | | Jan 26 | | | | | | | | Friends, No state has faced opposition from its RINO Republican leadership quite like the South Carolina Freedom Caucus (SCFC). Less than a month into the 2024 session, the attacks have gotten even worse than last year. The Palmetto State has a "Republican" supermajority in their legislature (88R-36D House, 30R-15D Senate), but an shows only Republicans in Hawaii have more liberal voting records. In last year's session, GOP leadership kicked the entire Freedom Caucus out of the SC House Republican Caucus. Why? They to sign a pledge to essentially never criticize their fellow Republicans. This year, they're trying to muzzle the SCFC by shutting down debate. Led by RINO GOP Majority Leader Davey Hiott, South Carolina Republicans are proposing a new rules package for the House this year that limits the amount of amendments that members can bring forward on any given bill. Not only that, but it gives the Majority and Minority Leaders sole authority to choose which amendments actually get voted on. So not only are they trying to shut conservatives out of the legislative process entirely, they want to give Democrats the procedural power to help them do it! The same Democrats who technically have zero leverage to have any control in the process. To put it as simply as we can - RINO Republicans are teaming up with the Democrats to shut down the SC Freedom Caucus by preventing them from offering conservative amendments to their big government bills. In a state where Trump beat Biden by double-digits, this is nothing short of INSANE. Thankfully, after the SC Freedom Caucus raised the alarm on social media and to the grassroots, leadership was forced to delay a vote on the rules package. But the RINOs will keep trying. This fight isn't over. Read more about it in this piece. Believe it or not, the RINOs in South Carolina recently did something else that is equally bad, if not worse! There is currently a judicial vacancy in South Carolina's 5th Circuit Court, and the legislature is in charge of approving nominations for the bench. Now given the fact that SC has a "Republican supermajority," you'd think their choice would be a rock-ribbed conservative in the mold of Justice Clarence Thomas. But you couldn't be more wrong. The leading candidate that RINO Republicans want to put on the bench is a man named James Smith. He was the state's Democrat nominee for Governor in 2018 and the former Democrat Minority Leader in the State House. He's pro-Biden, pro-abortion, and pro-Medicaid expansion. Yet despite this, Smith has the support from a majority of Republicans in the House for this judicial seat. Why? Because he's part of the "Good Ol' Boys" network. If confirmed, can you imagine the kind of damage he could inflict by "legislating from the bench"? The SC Freedom Caucus will fight to ensure that his candidacy is terminated. If they can't kill the nomination ahead of time, we anticipate the vote for his confirmation will be held in early February. "This judicial race highlights exactly why South Carolina desperately needs both a reformed judicial system and more reform-minded, true conservatives in the South Carolina General Assembly," said State Freedom Caucus Network's SC Director Evan Newman. Celebrating Michigan's Rich History
As we gather today to commemorate the 187th birthday of our dear Michigan, I find myself reflecting on the journey we've embarked on together, the challenges we've overcome, and the opportunities that lie ahead.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Celebrate with us! Your contributions go directly towards a campaign that truly represents the needs and aspirations of the greatest state in the union. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
CELEBRATE WITH $10.87 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=10.87&refcode=express_lane_10.87]
CELEBRATE WITH $18.37 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=18.37&refcode=express_lane_18.37]
CELEBRATE WITH $187 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob?express_lane=true&amount=187&refcode=express_lane_187]
Friend,
Our state, founded on January 26, 1837, has weathered many storms. From its origins with our Indigenous people, the fur trading industry, the copper boom, and the rise of the automotive industry, we have forever shown pure Michigan grit.
It's that resilience and tenacity I'm eager to bring to Congress.
To take this endeavor forward, I need your support. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] Together, we can ensure the legacy of our state continues onward, forward, and up.
I am biased, but the First Congressional District represents the best of Michigan. It deserves to be protected, nurtured, and cared for.
>From the Eben Ice Caves to Sleeping Bear Dunes National Lakeshore, from the cliffs of Pictured Rocks to the wineries of Traverse City, there's always a thrilling adventure to embark upon. Northern Michigan and the UP offer natural beauty, outdoor activities, pristine waters, the toughest small businesses and people on the planet.
As we celebrate Michigan's 187th birthday today, let's not just look back on our state's history, but also look forward to the future we can build together; A future where every Michigander has access to quality healthcare, where our economy thrives on the backbone of small businesses and a reignited labor movement, and where our natural resources are preserved for generations to come.
Thank you for your generosity and loyalty to my journey to Congress and, most importantly, your belief in the potential of Michigan's progress and prosperity.
Happy birthday, Michigan! 187 years never looked so fresh.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan, Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

# [Nanoplastics Are Invading Our Blood, Cells, and Organs. Demand Companies Go Plastic-Free Now!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2bece906-1630-498d-8a1a-8daed76ac4ef/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9da587fa-5460-4baf-9b8d-6cc3e1232f7a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | You've probably already heard that, on average, we're drinking a credit card's worth of microplastics every single week. That already sounded bad, but now we're learning more information - and it's worse. Researchers just published a groundbreaking study showing that, on average, **plastic water bottles sold at grocery stores contain 240,000 pieces of nanoplastics** that then spread throughout our bodies. **Nanoplastics are even tinier than microplastics** \- which makes them more dangerous for human health. **They shed from plastic products, including water bottles and takeaway food containers.** [**There's one way to stop this horrible trend now: companies must no longer be allowed to produce or use plastic products for food and beverages. Sign the petition to major world governments now!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te1664686-914a-40ae-baa3-a1390e01b6a7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Because of their infinitesimally tiny size, nanoplastics can travel into and invade our cells, bloodstreams, and organs - including our brains. In fact, some studies have even identified nanoplastics and microplastics in human placentas, meaning we can pass these along to the next generation of children - before they've even had a chance to properly ingest tiny plastic particles for themselves. Additionally, plastics are manufactured using a variety of chemicals, and are themselves made out of fossil fuels. Plastics deposited in our bodies have been linked to cellular and endocrine disruption. _This is what is now lodged inside our bodies, and they don't disappear._ **The particles just build up more and more inside our systems.** No generation on Earth has ever faced this level of plastic pollution or plastic usage. And now it's having a frightening effect. **Luckily, there are alternatives to plastic.** Some are new technologies, like compostable products, and others have existed for generations, including the use of metal, paper, and glass instead. **That's why we're calling on major international governments, including the United States, European Union, India, and Japan to ban corporations from using or manufacturing plastic. Companies must be required to replace these toxic polymers with sustainable, healthy alternatives instead![Sign the petition to protect human health and the environment now!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td294e234-078f-40da-95e2-0a172e22ec5c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

Nanoplastics are even tinier than microplastics \- which makes them more dangerous for human health. They shed from plastic products, including water bottles and takeaway food containers. Because of their infinitesimally tiny size, nanoplastics can travel into and invade our cells, bloodstreams, and organs - including our brains. In fact, some studies have even identified nanoplastics and microplastics in human placentas, meaning we can pass these along to the next generation of children - before they've even had a chance to properly ingest tiny plastic particles for themselves. Additionally, plastics are manufactured using a variety of chemicals, and are themselves made out of fossil fuels. Plastics deposited in our bodies have been linked to cellular and endocrine disruption. This is what is now lodged inside our bodies, and they don't disappear. The particles just build up more and more inside our systems. No generation on Earth has ever faced this level of plastic pollution or plastic usage. And now it's having a frightening effect. Luckily, there are alternatives to plastic. Some are new technologies, like compostable products, and others have existed for generations, including the use of metal, paper, and glass instead. That's why we're calling on major international governments, including the United States, European Union, India, and Japan to ban corporations from using or manufacturing plastic. Homelessness is often stereotyped. We often talk about the epidemic of homelessness that we see in Blue cities all across the country. But homelessness has many faces.
It all started with a street interview. As I was leaving a coffee shop in Des Moines, IA, a young man noticed my Vivek Ramaswamy sticker and asked if he could record a quick interview regarding the then-upcoming caucus. While I was answering his questions, a group of three ladies passed by, and one of them got in front of the camera and asked, "Is this live?"
We went out to eat, I discovered they were all homeless and living in a shelter. Over the next month I got to know 1 of the 3 women well - Chaya. Listen. Share. Subscribe.
Blessings...
[](https://substack.com/redirect/bc3981d5-8f00-402a-ab99-ba4d9c1a249f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The harsh reality, with prices being what they are today, especially housing prices, is that many of us find ourselves just *one paycheck* away from needing help. If you don't have family or friends around, you can quickly enter the vicious circle of homelessness.
This episode is worth a listen. I honestly learned a lot about homelessness through my conversations with these young ladies. I don't want my kids to have the same image of homelessness that I initially had.

name: Victor Riches
subject: Freedom depends on school choice
body:
Parents are looking for ways to choose the right education for their children

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=dbafb44152874428abb2275f46425a26&_e=Eii7VToUr1PdN3pw6hKSiUwqzgL_6cfqOocPNUBja6uer8hpwppk_Rrkxu9C9z_h21_YJBfcIp_GcDUf2T1Gvv9HIiza_wXR_ZMXZIXKE3B2odRf0M61SntiIXTLi7FaXHsRaOMiEfet9f6yzx6SAmCwGh5OO-LhQ4_kbCfmFx0fASNktJzFrm_Dh_m1WHsU9WFroIoGOaydPikiAkSZ78-rDt7e8itATr_kCgNTPle9gWhv7bB8yEImXBmRWk4-_1w9gWfjARqdNN8W7XDUaW99qtSYFQGgauZGPnAQvNU%3D)

Friend,

Since the founding of our country, education, and democracy have gone hand in hand. Our Founders knew education was critical to keeping a free republic.

President Reagan, who agreed with our Founding Fathers, once said:

clean_body: | = This week, Ohio became the latest state to ban gender-affirming care for trans youth and ban trans girls from sports. But this isn’t an issue just in Ohio. The Buckeye State joined nearly two dozen states who’ve passed similar bans across the country. And if Republicans in Washington had their way, they’d pass the same exact bills nationally. = | = This bigoted bill only passed because the Ohio GOP rigged the state courts and then gerrymandered themselves into a veto-proof majority, a playbook that GOP-led legislatures have followed across the country. Why? To pick fights against the most vulnerable among us... and literally ignore the will of the voters or any of the pressing issues facing families in their everyday lives. This bill places government in between patients and providers (sound familiar?) and keeps trans young people from playing with their friends. After voters elected 7 progressive members to the state Board of Education, the Ohio GOP all but dissolved the Board to create a new department led by the Republican Governor’s appointees. They’re also working to overturn the pro-abortion ballot initiative passed by 57% of voters less than three months ago. The GOP’s attacks on trans rights, women’s rights, public education, and more are all a part of their all-out assault on our democracy. Congress is now led by Rep. Mike Johnson, the most anti-trans, anti-woman Speaker of the House we’ve seen in our lifetimes. He’s 3rd in line to the presidency and determines which bills get put on the House floor for discussion, debate, and votes. He supports nationwide bans on gender-affirming care, abortion, and same-sex marriage. clean_body: | | | Peter, Since we wrote to you earlier this week, some major news in this race broke: Jamaal Bowman’s primary opponent has been officially endorsed by AIPAC in their very first endorsement of a non-incumbent this cycle.1 We already knew AIPAC was planning to spend at least $100 million to unseat progressive champions and take full control of Congress for MAGA Republicans. Now we know Jamaal is #1 on their target list — and we need to make sure he has the resources he needs to fight back. AIPAC and the billionaire right-wing donors who fund them are planning to spend millions to unseat WFP champions like Jamaal in 2024 because they know they are unbought and unafraid. Their ultimate plan is not only to try and silence their voices — but to cause enough distraction and dissension to give MAGA Republicans full control of Congress and put Trump back in the White House. The truth is we will never match GOP megadonors in races like this one dollar for dollar. But the good news is, we don’t need to. If we can just make sure candidates like Jamaal have the resources they need to get their message out to their constituents, we can win. name: Team Daniels
subject: FW: I am the ethical leader we need on AI in Politics
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Daniels For Congress
body:
Dear Friend,
Team Daniels here. We wanted to make sure that you didn't miss this important message from Shamaine. In the time since we launched our first AI powered calls to voters last month, a lot has happened.
As we all expected, the 2024 campaign cycle has started with numerous stories about artificial intelligence being used to deceive and mislead voters. That is why Shamaine's leadership on this issue is so important.
In stories around the country, our campaign is being recognized for using AI in a way that is ethical, transparent, and that strengthens our Democracy by making more people a part of the conversation about who should lead our country.
The bottom line is that Shamaine's leadership on this issue is important to the future of our Democracy, and we couldn't be more proud to be a part of her team.
It's almost the end of the month, and we're asking you to support our pioneering campaign with a contribution to help us reach our January fundraising goal. Please click here to make a contribution before January 31st! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Thanks for being a part of our team!
- Team Daniels
Begin Forwarded Message
January 25, 2024
From: Shamaine Damiels
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics [https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics]
Dear Friend
Last month our campaign made international news [https://www.politico.com/news/2023/12/12/democratic-campaign-ai-caller-00131180] when we became the first campaign in the world to use a voice-powered artificial intelligence agent ("Ashley") to reach voters. At that time, there was a lot of discussion about the ethical implications of using AI in political campaigns. My team and I thought long and hard about those ethical questions, and decided that we wanted to lead from the front by utilizing this cutting edge technology in a way that is fully ethical, truthful and transparent.
In the last week, the deceitful and unethical use of this kind of technology has made its own headlines. These stories have highlighted the need for ethical leadership, and a recent story on NPR acknowledged our campaign's leadership on this important issue.
I'm reaching out today to ask you to support my campaign so that I can continue to provide the leadership we need on this issue as a candidate, and as a member of Congress.
Contribute [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
You can listen to the entire discussion from "On Point" HERE [https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics] , courtesy of NPR affiliate WBUR in Boston.
https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics [https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics] Experts in the field of artificial intelligence's influence on politics are recognizing our ethical use of AI , and it has sparked a vitally necessary national conversation. We are proud to lead from the front on this issue, and we're asking for a contribution today so that we can continue to do so.
Making me and my positions more accessible to voters, decreasing the influence of big money on our politics by leveling the playing field, and bringing more people from more diverse backgrounds into the conversation about who represents them in Washington, these are all positive steps for our Democracy and they were our goals when we agreed to partner with Civox [https://www.civox.com/] on this project. Will you help us continue to provide leadership on this issue by making a contribution today?
Click the button below to contribute [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Contribute [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics [https://www.wbur.org/onpoint/2024/01/17/ai-influence-election-2024-politics]
What's the flip side of the coin? The unethical use of AI technology in political life is already becoming a reality. In just the past week, AI has been used to mislead voters in Harlem [https://www.politico.com/newsletters/new-york-playbook/2024/01/23/faked-ai-audio-hits-harlem-politics-00137132] and New Hampshire [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2024/01/23/fake-biden-robocall-fuels-calls-ai-regulation/] , and it's only January. In the year ahead, we can expect to see more stories like this, and we are all worried about the impact this could have the 2024 election and beyond.
As a candidate, I am leading by example, but in Congress, I will do more . Our regulatory framework is insufficient to deal with this emerging technology, and it is only falling further behind. If you believe we need leadership on this issue in the halls of Congress, I am asking for your support. Actions speak louder than words, and my actions tell you that this issue is more than just talk for me. You can count on me to continue leading on this issue, and I'm asking for your support so I can do so.
This issue is crucial to the future of our Democracy. Please consider making a contribution today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Contribute [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=e871f1ed99&e=a20d8ad2ed)
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: [press@nancyforalaska.com](mailto:press@nancyforalaska.com)
**Statement from Nancy Dahlstrom on Biden’s Decision to Pause LNG Projects**
**Anchorage, AK** \- Today, the Biden Administration [announced](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=6dd646ddfb&e=a20d8ad2ed) a pause on Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) exports throughout the country. Republican candidate for U.S. Congress and current Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom released the following statement:
_“Time and time, Biden has worked against Alaska, passing over 50 executive actions that directly harm our state and our people. Now, he has decided to pause LNG projects which is disastrous for our great state. Pausing LNG projects threatens our national security and stifles economic opportunities and future potential. I am calling on President Biden to reverse this decision.”_
Dahlstrom is running against Mary Peltola who has endorsed Joe Biden and works hand-in-hand with his administration. Republican Nancy Dahlstrom currently serves as the Lt. Governor for the state of Alaska. As Lieutenant Governor, Nancy has prioritized public safety, energy security, and emergency preparedness.
# # #

| | Dear Peter,I hope the first few weeks of 2024 have been treating you well, and that if you were in the path of the storm, you made it through unscathed! I always like to sit down with my family to set some goals for the year, and I know many of you do the same.This year, my goals aren’t _just_ personal ones. **We’ve got a big goal to restore trust and accountability in our state’s government – and that means winning our campaign for Secretary of State.****_

We’re all about leading with honesty and integrity, and it's paying off. Team Read continues to grow — more and more elected officials, labor unions, and community leaders are endorsing our campaign because they believe that together, we can get this job done. We’re starting 2024 with momentum, and that’s thanks to your generous support of our campaign. But we have our work cut out for us. The Secretary of State is responsible for being the chief elections officer, the chief auditor, and overseeing the Oregon Corporation Division and the State Archives. **It’s going to be our job to make sure voters know ahead of the upcoming primary that we are prepared to meet the responsibilities of this office. **** **That’s why I’m counting on your investment in our campaign, especially in this critical moment.**[** We’re facing our very first fundraising deadline of the election year and we’ve set a goal to raise $10,000 from supporters like you – will you please make a donation before our deadline on January 31st?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77804950/451534346/-1069759033?refcode=20240226&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDE4MzMyOS03ZGJjLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ids6JZbXVMZjDXZomASWoA63ZFpdmD2XvX6BRN_yaZA=)****

| | Peter, **As if on cue, Lori Chavez-DeRemer is back in line with Donald Trump when it comes to obliterating the right to a safe and legal abortion.** Last week, **she voted to shame and browbeat pregnant students** who might choose to seek abortions. Sure, the bill has a harmless-looking name, the Pregnant Students Rights' Act – but in reality, this legislation requires colleges to provide their students biased and misleading information about their reproductive care options. **This is just another part of the GOP's multi-prong scheme to chip away at reproductive freedom however and wherever possible.** Laws like these are about shaming pregnant women and guilt-tripping them with Focus on the Family-style propaganda instead of butting the hell out of deeply private, individual health decisions. Laws like these are about the consistent erosion of a long-held women's right to make decisions about their own bodies. And after decades of inaction, Washington has recently been on the _brink_ of a bipartisan step forward. But now Donald Trump has told his toadies to take no action on the border so that he can use it as an issue to campaign on in 2024. And David Schweikert has a big choice to make: **bow down to his extremist leader, Donald Trump, or take _real_ action on the border crisis.** We have no doubt that Republicans are going to make the border their issue to run on in 2024 — across America and here in Arizona. But one reason Andrei’s campaign has been getting historic levels of support is that Democrats know that, as a former border prosecutor, he has the credibility and experience to take this fight to David Schweikert. [**Andrei can play offense and not just defense on the border in the way few other Democrats in America can. But he needs your support today to ensure our campaign has the ability to bring voters that message. Peter, can you chip in to help us win this key election?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77807765/451540228/-677050522?refcode=AU_AHC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240126_PM1_V1_S2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTg3ZjQ5YjUtN2ZiYy1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NQEsNftFduzKcl1y6GRMixOR3f4BB7doeE4jMhKQfc0=) This week, Mitch McConnell told a closed-door group of Republican senators that they wouldn't confront the border crisis because _“We don’t want to do anything to undermine"_ Trump. Now he has to answer a simple question: **Does Representative Schweikert represent Arizona or Donald Trump?** As Arizona Assistant Attorney General, Andrei helped bust and prosecute one of the largest human smuggling operations in the state's history. Friend, Earlier today, the International Court of Justice ordered the Israeli government to act immediately to prevent a genocide of the Palestinian people. As Jeremy Scahill of _The Intercept_ wrote:
> _“This ruling from the ICJ is a massive legal defeat for Israel and its premier defenders, the U.S. and Germany.”_
Meanwhile, the Biden administration continues to transfer bombs and other weapons to the Israeli government, despite overwhelming and credible evidence that they’re being used to commit war crimes. This week, some colleagues in Congress joined me in demanding the U.S. Government Accountability Office and President Biden enforce their own policies and U.S. laws around aiding the Israeli military. The Leahy Laws prohibit U.S. assistance to foreign militaries when credible information indicates a “gross violation of human rights,” including “prolonged detention without charges and trial” and “flagrant denial of the right to life, liberty, or the security of person.” In addition, the Biden administration’s own Conventional Arms Transfer Policy states that arms transfers will not be authorized if the arms will be used to commit genocide, crimes against humanity, or other serious violations of international humanitarian or human rights law. [**Please sign on to amplify our demands of President Biden and the U.S. Government Accountability Office: Assess the Israeli government’s human rights compliance with your own policy and U.S. law—and if not, enforce these policies without delay and stop U.S. military assistance to Israel’s government.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmQip0KI8h0I2D6ae1eIF_QzHx-Ll4G7ea1tHQ_4P0Cj-LXKqGAXqQcEe1shhRCSUlYlXZTFYsnnF6IYJ1oYj0R-F9NfH75MC6SJh_VLhBBEMZF3S5MVvwGZOhYBdWh2L0jiM9FcMW0R9GwNF2dy1spX9Lywsef9S5gmk-wmEg9X6DpKaq9gFfIzkux0bAianlFsSRzlmNcOp2awYpTyUJ19GL-B7HqzAiR8VijZOWO45IkzelVDOJiP7AVEkLbJdafPPkZW-neV0zlsHMzzD_EL5l575PBQkLGgtlEuWJY2iiUN4UZCAUsdTbfWBUtH7jiBSEbuu-XEZ8yMetkIlq-ADfnehKRsp1skN7ZDDz48fCablwM-v9pa59LroHAK3MTl3fzPl3P-NFHmiRKg-KSEJ5fEnHHp22L0QMMyFVDtIqIXcfLx83nj6L5ct5eQH9B2VByvjo68j596SnedWqzysGX33abj0jaoOiX6J1nAvDjmzZFsiLbFsGcoIq46WN1dZkrhjdhXiXjKkpEy9emHis16Zluok8c_mog2aYIMg/43b/OLLxElmLQ423yKAGPAisKg/h1/CK2Je3kHzobL_SQbkCmwGICxH4nOcho7H7cwwuSMy0s)**** | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmQip0KI8h0I2D6ae1eIF_QzHx-Ll4G7ea1tHQ_4P0Cj-LXKqGAXqQcEe1shhRCSUlYlXZTFYsnnF6IYJ1oYj0R-F9NfH75MC6SJh_VLhBBEOQUFtrX2vPLDUBSyrE1DN-mMt_4hHrgyN8xIeapRD_yS5dDJSf2_wiZb7NhTAmriSbuPiPB7xMcBBvrhMlI2JOOJaEZBYy8UouD7bjmeGfNBiTrljTVAImG9jbabVKjhkIHrWpD2H40YqZsHqLm8N-DiYPY_yuihcyvJG_VyTQkAOl04K6A5_wYINDzxLDRtK83eSIlu-CqSuUnrE8xaMOyOOUdPbk9txwpQE2xI7FlwkffqhTYfLq5TXuDodhbPZaVvkGsOIB_NNM09eQBNilRJ07xYaBd1jJRCBByXTdnqk8Na-OgesXAjyr0QAbOR2w-zZEhcT1-mHNxyhoE4EnYK4KEdAlAREs5jTViTxKmhmUVMw6WEB9i9vqOZoRpWJXRltovX2p8wDdQxtHHTBsAP-YdRWn2ulqP9rlfoC8V69jP1nOFREbqE-m8C3rW7w/43b/OLLxElmLQ423yKAGPAisKg/h2/MRN9oRZH89Dzf40gIey10wU-mQaWSkoRzeOxWifFGHE)

The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Run for Office and Bring Balance to Indiana From attacking Hoosier reproductive rights to mismanaging Medicaid funds, Indiana Republicans continue to show that we need more balance in our state government. Running for local office or statehouse is an incredible way to give back to your community and to help us restore this much needed balance. Indiana Democrats are here to support your candidacy and offer the tools you need to succeed. Republicans Seek to Destroy Wetlands Republicans passed a bill through the Indiana House this week that continues their on Hoosier wetlands. redefines wetlands so that less land is protected and developers can more easily buy and build on the land. The legislation is a direct assault on environmental conservation efforts and may have devastating effects on the plants and animals that inhabit wetlands. It will allow developers to haphazardly swoop in without any regard for the environment, including flood risks from extreme storms. While Republicans look to destroy wetlands, Democrats look to build resilient communities. Republicans should join Indiana Democrats in our efforts to care for our state, protect our drinking water, prepare for extreme weather, and ensure Hoosier children and grandchildren will inherit a beautiful state and planet. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. State Representative Carey Hamilton is sponsoring legislation that will help prevent lenders from taking advantage of Hoosiers. House Bill 1171 will cap payday loan interest at 36%. It’s estimated that this legislation, if law, would have saved Hoosier borrowers This cost-saving policy will help protect the most vulnerable Hoosiers across the state. It is endorsed by Hoosiers for Responsible Lending and Prosperity Indiana.
