| | I told you earlier this week about a ridiculous decision that came down from the [Supreme Court](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrfFosGkYZKQU4SXUa9H4uLlfgjtA1D8xNczbknNdZ629jM4NFJ5KfELbuN9snAdJ_dbnzTg5o0DEkTTZIyQjYZD8SJz0b1NRDi1M3q0iUKCorB6wGoYyU_UfWhbFDMGr0Lt_EeYVP5XXpMY15cOs3IbpfdR0YjWLFXs4kiaSytrjzsxjnXKB5nxM6_rYZ_eMOiIH06ciOxejAXHVZ5phdnoqi-W_ZspessuuWIquYl-t5ZKt0Ua0OYojARjnZs85zPdLcAb5HsA6XYFqposc2oo%3D). To refresh your memory, they foolishly sided with the Biden administration’s policy allowing Border Patrol agents to slash through Texas’ [razor wire](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrRtkwQ6kryxXh8Cg4EY-svAQvd6dJ0f14JLPrL3vuwm9SEF5GRFF9M9LCQpV1minWpqXY8qPvgOkhQEwd9Tu6e9_pY47aCQVD7RLx4wMkMaY4e6BGRCl8Ew4DLADT29pCtzTPhLDm12w3fblZzrgEOtlG1uFv35N5vdiLDMFYGYvq1CpGnihRQhIF5Qrb25EtmPc_vaCxR4rGgM99goqU4TFIScWwIj13Gx5IB7Gjo65dNhTxxo_7EEEqvI3u0orfK7djDKDlrhw6MPzIR1v2182CTuK_485kwtMpPfRjvxg) installed along the most dangerous areas of the southern border. As far as I’m concerned, Texas leaders have no other choice. Our federal government has all but [abandoned](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrZn6PPK2VrTea8swmQPSczdvjbB6Gi9z_gojc7iwAUCaJE_in9RJzFhs_dtT7F2I0_9AauY8Y4xefd-T6yh3ZSg7YD3APvN0d3TRmC6SA9ZMsKTRFj15drMZGIceP_ldVUCwKWXdXRHBoAdJmNCGTD1u1oUF5yAVob75opIwzNPUpMwoZClh0cn1DfK7m9HjhOz5had0PaGYMfCqbV_0c7d3PNQ9aDongE8_m2nmpnhWL2itJf57X9JbdCUAseqlfg%3D%3D) our border states—leaving them to fend for themselves in the middle of a nightmare that is getting worse by the day. If you don’t believe me, take a look at the numbers below. Spoiler alert: they don’t lie!
* Migrant encounters at the border reached a [whopping all-time high](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrXpyjCTJ9NT5DUjPr0CP7RTKoN9whGG-ndGbNYbxQM4T0kItgdbo6j6tdL5ZyfDA8WnG4mdcNyusSSU4LLHWmoE11fEyC0c8C8-qaotOsbiIgTjaxDS6GLVuXZybG9uv6bF352RCTypf_kiU7nTZqymNzAFplLgsF9FVzaLxqXJzBOnS7Ptpe8BZlDnLgnHcyAEIlpMDnBvE_zkVgK0-AslA3pEncZWSvLoVD-Jt6hfMxefJxMLcERS6u2mVD9cioVbbFLBD5M3Mty_gLLmb4-Qvh5bINLZi9Zej0Fd8UXwh) of 302,000 in December
* 600,000 [‘gotaways’](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrTVGP2KRAPbtXpK2ZGg6H1001oRJ5JVe2AG6Rs5XMqi7hqkeUb-wzIm3k_frE0Q8LwL0pnXqiVfc3gv4_2H2WTASLd6ml6VbOZKbkN-AwbQN_GfC5QDEEbHS_16LBtiB3_tyoPRT-fEY0VfTx0ztW6wXiur8KTRht_qWuV9RPHGsioiGfmDc6heyCfhBMTLma82enIt7UFD7C5mt1TRXXnPkLVnfY9dXkl688h73sFawTbtcTNbC3IjajHXY6Po5VgoLjYpt0jmo7GEgPM0eqDo%3D) weaseled their way past border agents and into America last year alone
* We could be on the hook for [$451 billion](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrTVGP2KRAPbtXpK2ZGg6H108-IByH03hawqKTcLMUwmwV8pW68c-hJDFEsJ2Xi8TkIcsQc851Al83vtqRmOW_PN8cy71IjqK_n5WIarLmUhBwGnCASTmAxe3GRUkUrWkQ7xEN4JJjPWuw_Mu8-BNCXDfCGKMl7tTa9bgIKeSu4C6oO0gW75cS8EPgQz1Fdi9U9Z9R1FiurXL6a6Xo3CfoqH1xaFwRtuDrnjMMq7OpFJcfygOmCLnMWCorHi-s_SfxZp71Ld2lCAJ5NkMCPcUJ6I5p_zOl-XQgPm_jR7fc0Lu) to care for these illegal immigrants

I’m not going to sit around and let this all unfold without a fight. Like so many others, I’ve expressed my [support](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrZg2jlhb6luIXDzCji57C93Z95lX_RcfriVJswXVuXln4Vnhf_C1Z44AdhAmgP4YR6Xw1BxaM-8NTAYuLbQhPWXErlKZW_6akDJn-p2UUE6G-X1R06rSLGEcCMuU_NyjbFQnL-F0pXC4lqzeztt0fL_3USEKp2kWNWkkZTt00XBbezvkSAyMewrctrDDAXJRdn7OOkrG0fIoOHSLuPmkJ3b85xLHut0K2hI_ufovx2AX) for Texas Governor Greg Abbot, encouraging him to hold the line—and now I’m co-sponsoring a bill that will help. Representative Mike Collins (R-Ga.) is leading the charge for us, introducing the Restricting Administration Zealots from Obliging Raiders [(RAZOR) Act](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrV5SZ8rFSopBZSdZZl2k_N8HMzuUGhzXE0etSyTdNTKfGFDHN6NSjqPeveE2eedcDM_-H1wjdzU6fcpCPmYV0-3NVq3eXM7LySM3DzW5e96rx3vmoS28xIWFvhYHGaLR0nhAk29nWg2Xz0vSpTty6a0r_nZZBo4qxZAe_CnpHjabMt4Y4EBapIISTWCuCDuny_P3oWjKcrXNgOvGKC73uqDh1p5FPpTVvmPTrZROZQO5fWsqvEHh_6CAGv_p-csWlmChTNUjYfo1JyrkO_6ZnhX5tdaV4GkzO8AH6DK_b99o). It would ban the government from trashing any state-constructed barrier that’s being used to keep illegal immigrants out of this country—and that’s exactly how it should be. Governor Abbott’s actions aren’t political theater; they’re a desperate attempt to do his dadgum job and protect his citizens from an [invasion](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUrfFosGkYZKQU4SXUa9H4uLnMDXEKTTXShujp32g62GLSe5M_BUlIzEZZur5Hu9F8cpl5bAb8XLtHPwQPwf3PMHem-LPK2h49XeJtET-S064e7oNz8QmKGFOwxoNEz1T3pgLSYSb4Bqx4bhsPt0rgbX3H5mScSFEn8jJMmf1x8XENswQ1ovK708x_Yr3TB5CG61pckZPSro85n0dh4TKCiww7gviDMZU9HgQ606YiQANAZwywRURmswuSGlGkzs2A9OMk8PZDP7uOn3c6ya8utVF-TXQ1m4HJIlSOXakAcwQebSgE6z0y6Jd2C_4lvqJ1MA%3D%3D) of massive proportions. I plan on standing firmly to ensure he has what he needs to fight for his state’s sovereignty.

| | Old man winter threw everything he had at Knoxville over the last week. This latest winter storm packed snow, ice, and frigid temperatures that made it tough to get around, but fortunately, a [Good Samaritan](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=cd9f47d08cd741af82982c2638cfebf2&_e=kv8RrtwEHe5Wb8E5bcaUraHKv85DYI-qPQhO25b0g8orFhcq2KMlfJ4zo4aeNk3h7xqC6stbWqKCFM2BB0gPk0qQwavM0sgOSmYxw8ijIhq0v4kMfyYP5E1lUJBwqow2OY_9uzTl8FzK6jikcKHvOK9Fcm8QHIBp8x5uPr_poFEgXgp0mJ_0fhLgo_m-WvGH2NhU1TwNmiztV_XjCHLjUgYW-5lkwsPosrz6GXAuPT9_cHffX0F92Y7pnZj5GlZRW7MLULBuO2Qe_tMb_Evgwtm97ycEgMcWz-LLGvPyhneoFsWH-uA7qLKe2NVijp82s9A52cqBWd_Q3RA7oMRbyA%3D%3D) stepped up to lend a helping hand. Charles Weaver has a sturdy Jeep Wrangler with rugged tires made for bad weather and off-roading, which is why he gave it the nickname, “Spartacus.” He figured he’d post on a local Facebook group to see if anyone needed help getting around in the storm, and sure enough, the requests kept rolling in. Charles saved the day for about 70 people stuck in their homes. Whether it was a nurse who needed to get to work or someone in desperate need of grabbing groceries, Charles and Spartacus were there to help. Another great show of that Volunteer State spirit we all know and love!

#
Friends,
Not even a week after what would have been the 51st anniversary of _Roe_ , Wisconsin Republicans continue their attempts to steal reproductive rights from Wisconsin women.
[](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-jan24.Ibl7yb&refcode=em240126-1-t1&t=1&akid=5171%2E196590%2EHor6z9)
That’s right. Wisconsin Republicans are trying to ban abortions after 14 weeks of pregnancy.
This bill blatantly defies women’s bodily autonomy and freedom to make choices about their bodies, all under the claim of being “pro-life.”
These are the same “pro-life” Republicans who refuse to pass comprehensive gun safety legislation to prevent mass shootings and save innocent lives.
These Republicans aren't “pro-life,” they are pro-birth. And they will do everything they can to inflict their personal beliefs on Wisconsin women.
This issue is personal. Before me, my mother had a complicated pregnancy that could’ve taken her life. Back then, she had the right to choose and decided to end the pregnancy. If my mom hadn't made that decision, I am not sure she or I would be here today.
Choice matters, yet Republicans continue to try to steal bodily autonomy from women.
We cannot let them continue to abuse their power to limit the rights of Wisconsinites. It’s time to take back the legislative majority in Wisconsin and elect pro-choice Democrats up and down the ballot this November.

## Legislative Update January 26th, 2024
---
| **Congress passes a disastrous Continuing Resolution (CR) fully funding Pelosi and Biden’s wishes** The most recent Continuing Resolution, passed on January 22, 2024 was a disaster on every front. The narrative to keep the “Government Open” and “National Security” was played for the umpteenth time as Congress seems unable to do their Constitutional job of setting a budget for the government. This Continuing Resolution continued the reckless spending spree of Congress and it failed the core planks of our platform. Let’s examine the details of this Continuing Resolution that almost no one took the time to read before it was passed. What this Continuing Resolution actually does; **Fails Recent Promises to the American people.** Seven months ago, this Congress raised our debt ceiling by $4 Trillion until January 2025 for modest caps. Unfortunately, those spending caps were violated by Speaker Johnson and Schumer insider deals in just seven months. Congress proved again that agreements made in the past are not worth the paper they are printed on. History proves their word is seldom good. Our advice is to ignore the tweets, messaging, etc by the professional PR gurus. The voting actions of DC rarely match the words. They would like you to believe they are tough on inflation, the border, and fiscal responsibility but the vote that matters says otherwise. Maybe less tweeting and more budget work is in order. ‘Tell the people what they want to hear but doing what “The Firm” wants’ (as Senator Mike Lee (R-UT) is now calling the behind the scenes power brokers). This is what is really happening as Senator Lee accurately states. **Fails to Secure the Border. ** Representative Jack Bergman (R-MI...former Lt. General in the Marine Corps—Oorah!) tweeted, ”If we don’t secure our borders, we won’t have a Nation to fund. Until Congress gets serious about securing the border - I will not support another dime of federal spending.” **We concur with Representative Bergman.** Until the Washington GOP learns to play hard ball with the purse, they will continue to fail to secure the border. The DC GOP needs more guts plain and simple. A Continuing Resolution without securing the border should have been dead on arrival. Unfortunately, this Congress, including Republicans, have a hard time saying no. When handouts to wealthy donors that fund these campaigns are in the budget, the peoples’ priorities lose. They say ‘secure the border’. They vote to keep the flood gates open by not securing the border. Be prepared in Nebraska and at the Federal level for the big money interests to fight to keep their special tax breaks and funding in place. Another failed promise of securing the border. Another failure of not listening to the people. **Feeding the Inflation Beast.** Even the most amateur business person knows inflation has been out of control due to the reckless spending of Congress and the unstoppable printing press of the Fed. We need real business minds in DC that understand basic economic principles. Big business minds have evolved into handouts and tax breaks via their bought and paid for politicians. We need better business minds that run businesses that can make it on their own without DC welfare and worry about overall economic climate issues...not direct payments and loopholes. The entire DC apparatus is to blame. The people are paying the price by not having the purse controlled and national Constitutional priorities addressed. While President Biden continues disastrous plans and spending, Congress still has the power to control the purse, yet they fail to use this power. While we were hopeful that Speaker Johnson would chart a new direction for the House, it appears he has not changed the course and still needs to be liked by the brass that have lost their way over executing a battle for American priorities. Expect more inflation with the runaway spending in this bill. America has now amassed over $34 Trillion in National Debt and is growing each second. Our interest payments will not be sustainable. **Failing to Defend Innocent Hostages.** Senator Paul (R-KY) tried to save innocent life in Israel by removing “Aid Funding” to Palestine in the continuing resolution until they released the hostages they abducted from their brutal attack and invasion of Israel. That amendment failed. Despite “Money for Hostages” not passing, they approved the spending bill anyway. Palestine is receiving money without having to release innocent hostages? Why is Palestine receiving ANY MONEY? When does innocent life matter over money? When do we stand with our Allies versus the terrorists? What happened on October 7th was heinous and disturbing. Yet, more disturbing is the antisemitism and acceptance of the pro-Palestine mobs all over the country. These demonstrations are more menacing and detrimental than J6 ever was. Our Congress sympathizes with these aggressors and funds them without changing their ways. Inexcusable. **Failing Pro-Life.** We are focused on driving this body and advancing Senators at election time that can actually achieve something of significance to save lives. We are moving past symbolic license plates and other gestures that do not actually save lives. We need to move past pro-life speeches and vote to defund Planned Parenthood. We are looking to save more lives in the future by changing the law and politicians who fail to stand for babies and innocent life. We hope 2023 was just the start of changing the direction of this state. As one of our most treasured planks, it cannot be overlooked that this Continuing Resolution will continue to fund Planned Parenthood. The strength is not there with these politicians to stand up to Planned Parenthood and push for life. Enabling the number one killer of babies in the budget yet again is one more reason this resolution should have received a “No” vote. Which matters more, the government staying open or innocent lives of babies? When does ‘the stand’ for ending the funding of the destruction of innocent life take place in DC? At the end of the day, the excuses to keep voting for these horrendous continuing resolutions are too many to count. **Funding the UN and World Health Organization.** Our platform states, “Continued participation in the UN should be contingent upon the enactment of long overdue changes in the way that institution functions”. The NEGOP has much stronger feelings on the UN than currently in the platform, but as stewards of the platform we can say that those changes have not been met. The UN should not be funded by our government based on this criteria. Furthermore, the platform is very specific on the damage the UN is doing to the US with their scientifically challenged climate goals. The World Health Organization needs no explanation for the damaging response to the country for the Coronavirus recommendations, which have mostly been proven to be misguided and political. We the People, will not bow to the UN. **Gun Control.** Representative Chip Roy (R-TX) summarized the bill (and gun control) when he said, “The[ @HouseGOP](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=fcc18c1634&e=25844e23a8) is about to join the[ @SenateGOP](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=75c3f6093f&e=25844e23a8) to continue - AGAIN - to fund the federal govt at Pelosi’s spending levels, & continue to fund all manners of horrible abuse of power & policies from open borders & gun control to the UN and the WHO. All GOP should oppose.” The NEGOP concurs with Representative Chip Roy. How a Republican could vote for this CR is truly astonishing. It is time for the Republican citizens to ignore the rhetoric and pay attention to the votes that actually determine the outcome. Our mantra hasn’t changed. Our platform values need to advance in law and not just rhetoric. Principles over relational politics. Going back on promises, funding planned parenthood, not securing the border, feeding the inflation beast, fiscal irresponsibility, funding Palestine without releasing hostages, funding the UN, WHO, and all their gun control measures .... This bill should have been dead on arrival by ALL Republicans. Unfortunately, it wasn’t. This truly was another tragic vote. We will continue to work with Republicans that seek to advance our platform and have the fortitude to stand up to Biden and exercise the power of the purse.

## Governor Gives State of State Address
---
| The Governor’s State of the State was delayed by 45 minutes by Omaha Democrats due to what they considered ‘disrespect to North Omaha’. After those speeches, the Governor hit the major points of what he is looking to achieve in this session in his State of the State. He is seeking to cut property taxes by 40%. These initiatives would be in addition to what was passed in the prior year with Senator Briese’s initiatives. You can read more about property taxes in length in our previous legislative update.

**The Governor mentioned that LB575 is important (the Sports and Spaces bill). We are thrilled this is a priority. This has been part of our legislative plan to defend women’s rights in sports. We must bring focus to Education and School Systems which is why the fight for School Choice continues. There are too many dark forces that believe in changing the fabric of this country and communities through indoctrination of children. We must have options. We must have School Choice.**

Finally, a great deal of emphasis was placed on addressing workforce issues. This is consistent with the drumbeat of multiple outside entities. More on workforce can be read in the previous legislative update and below. Finally, a touching moment that caught the Governor was a salute to 2 of our workers who died while serving Nebraska on the roads. Accolades from the Governor, Senators, (as well as the NEGOP) for the work we have seen to dig Nebraska out of these severe storms has been amazing. We appreciate the sacrifice of our public servants who worked to keep our state moving. **##READ THIS OF ALL STATEMENTS##** If we do not clean up our Photo Voter ID to be _SPECIFIC_ to presenting the Photo ID as you __**CAST**__ your ballot, we will lose the Pro-Life battle in Nebraska for a long, long time. If we do not require a ballot be directly **HANDED or TURNED** into an election official while the voter **PRESENTS** a qualified **PHOTO ID** , our Nebraska Constitution will forever have Abortion as a _**Right**_ in Nebraska.

The ballot initiative to alter the Nebraska constitution will MORE than likely gain the sufficient petition signatures to be placed on our November ballots. Those who persist to enshrine Abortion as a Human Right will ballot harvest throughout **Lancaster, Douglas, and Sarpy** counties and they WILL get the 50% +1 "votes" they need.

__**The biggest Pro-Life bill for Nebraska in 2024 is Photo Voter ID requirements cleanup bill and we cannot amplify this message enough.

Save babies with a Photo Voter ID cleanup language.**__

## Violation of Nebraska's Constitution
(Unicameral Rules Debate)
---
| In 2023 we saw five of our seven planks of the Legislative Plan succeed. However, election integrity and rules did not succeed. We were happy to see the Legislative session kickoff with a debate on rules. At the heart of the rules discussion, was a defense of the Constitution. The NEGOP supports our Nebraska and Federal Constitution as written. Article III Section 11 states “All votes shall be viva voce”. ‘Viva voce’ means to vote by speaking out loud or “Open Voting”. The courts have ruled that votes ‘on the board’ are consistent with “Viva Voce”. The Constitution was also clear with the word “All”. We have ignored the rules (the Constitution) the people have put on the government before they put rules over the people by taking secret votes for committee chairs. The secret votes have led to mistrust among Senators and a lack of being able to hold elected leaders accountable for the votes they are taking. The arguments by some Senators that this was about Republican partisan games or ‘we’ were trying to suppress minority voices, etc are all false and were gamesmanship to motivate their liberal base. This rule was about transparency, ending secrecy, and following the Constitution for this public body. Unfortunately, the Democrats (apologies to Senator Wayne who made the correct vote) and select Republicans who didn’t return our rules to Constitutional observance. They will continue to hide their votes in secret. We truly appreciate Senator Erdman and ALL Republicans who voted to protect the Constitution. If you can violate one clause...you can violate them all. Our number one goal at the NEGOP is to defend the Constitution....the ultimate protector of minority rights from the majority. More on the rules discussion can be heard on the ‘Toddcast’ with Senator Erdman at [ne.gop/toddcast](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=8e72e89efa&e=25844e23a8). After the Constitutional failure, Senator Hansen then brought a rule to the floor to limit the number of bills a Senator can introduce a year. This was a good rule to increase the quality and limit the quantity of bills that are happening each year. Unfortunately, the original bill was continually amended to allow for more and more bills to obtain the necessary vote count. The final number of bills a Senator can now bring is 20. The rule then passed. This twenty bill limit will not stop the less quality that is happening at the Unicameral. However, we appreciate the effort of Senator Hansen and his staff to do the right thing. We are glad the first step has been taken (which was hard work)...but we look for more progress in the future. Big government, excessive government, and a lack of critical analysis occurs with this volume of bills. Pray for the bill drafters office. I’m surprised we don’t have a carpal tunnel office in their chamber for the amount of work they are doing on the keyboard. God bless them.

## Infrastructure
---
| The NEGOP Legislative Plan supports infrastructure. LB 600 made it past the first round. This Bill would give grants of up to $5 million to locales if they can demonstrate need and provide a 25% match to these funds. This was Senator Lippincott’s priority bill. Senator Clements wants to watch how the budget comes in to make sure there is room for $10 million in these expenditures. Senator Clements is an excellent budget hawk and we appreciate his efforts to control the purse (take notes Congress). This program is only eligible to towns under 100k in population.
---
|
---
|
## Work Force
---
| As we guided you in the last Legislative update, ‘workforce’ is a consistent drumbeat in the halls. Labor shortage is a reality for most all sectors. With labor shortage as a backdrop, there are several bills being drafted. Here is a small sampling.... Senator Ibach has an apprentice bill that seeks to train people on public assistance and move them onto private rolls and off of public assistance. Business license overhaul is a hot item. The goal is to make it easier to move to Nebraska if you are in a skilled trade. The NEGOP supports reducing regulations to obtain a job. The last we checked they cut hair the same in Missouri as they do in Nebraska. The goal is to observe reciprocity in licensing from state to state on numerous jobs. Stay tuned. This concept appears to have the momentum needed to succeed. We are excited about this prospect for lower barriers to entry for Nebraska jobs. Finally, Senator Beau Ballard introduced LB 1400. This bill creates a state tax credit of up to $5k for those moving to Nebraska from out of state to cover moving expenses. The individual must make $70k+ in the job.
---
|
---
|
## Child Welfare
---
| LB 461 appears poised to easily move forward. This bill was aimed at the state’s procurement process for services. At the center of the debate was Saint Francis ministries who conducted child welfare services. Most of the debate was centered around cost can’t be the only consideration in services. In this case, they are absolutely correct. Behind the curtains, we were very concerned for the children and the services they received. At the NEGOP, our primary concern was the welfare of children, a priority shared by Republicans throughout the state. This is the bipartisan issue we can get behind.
---
|
---
|
## Education
---
| With much fanfare LB 1330 was introduced by Senator Murman. This bill aims to remove funding for diversity, equity, and inclusion training for employees and the associated DEI offices. This concept has gained momentum and spread like wildfire across the country and we are glad Nebraska is finally at the table. We stand against racism and advocate for equal opportunity. However, these programs have led to reverse discrimination. We remain committed to advocating for equality under the law for all Nebraskans. On another front, Senator Clements introduced a very positive bill (LB1027) to reduce the burdens on parents who select private, parochial, or home schooling. This bill is a no brainer. This helps parents easily direct the education of their children and reduces the hoops a family must jump through. Matching the requirements private parents must go through with public parent requirements is common sense and achieves equality before the law.

We cannot emphasize enough the attack on the future of Nebraska is in our education system. We must support students and the good teachers who want to develop the greatness of our children, but we are at an extreme disadvantage when dark money is funneled to our opposition. You must make a difference by running for your local school board or the Educational Service Units which distribute curriculum. You must help support School Choice
---
|
---
|

Alabama just executed an inmate using nitrogen hypoxia (suffocation), a method that the American Veterinary Medical Association declared too cruel to euthanize animals back in 2000.
Kenneth Eugene Smith was sentenced to death because the judge in his case used an old Alabama law to override the jury's decision to spare his life. This practice is now unconstitutional.

Friend, Joe Biden's economy has more inflation than a busy tire shop. In fact, I was just doing my holiday shopping and prices are **WAY** higher than they were last year.

The reason for that? Joe Biden’s failed economic agenda.

The President can lie to us all he wants, but nobody believes the American economy is on the right track. Go to the gas station, the grocery store, or pretty much anywhere in this country and you’ll find things are more expensive with Joe Biden in control.

And as long as Biden and his enablers in Congress are making the rules, things aren’t going to change.

That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate.

My name is Mike Rogers, and unlike Joe Biden, I actually have some private sector experience and knowledge of how an economy works.

As the son of a local chamber of commerce director, husband of a CEO, and business owner, I’ve had a lot of firsthand experience with businesses and economic forces.

So take it from me when I say that Joe Biden and his left-wing buddies have no idea what they’re doing.

I know that Joe Biden’s failed economy is hurting everyone, but the reality is that I can’t get in and fix it unless I have the resources to win this senate seat.

And with Democrats already pledging millions of dollars to defeat me, I’ve got my work cut out. Friend, **[anything that you can give, whether it’s $5, $10, $20](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=6e39c53d0fe14e469aef7509fb0dbb3a&_e=gYF7Pxki9EzRAt9cduiNYiVI2h9D1TjTvK2aXiiIVnfpKV8nlOzrJXv-y4G4UChyw9IM3LLoJfVR3vMIYbwwhufrAzr3TxNsomUBraDL4TzkDwd8yLdfXUwz1SjEKIqGmZwsSsaGz9wIJNuFU84JdEMfnlbiPSBjizcBtaPqOODZ9pKqZ6AbUEUPNJM4wBHJBvLHEA1mO9XNaDTryAqxMraEQo3R3mxpZEyakqYq_GzBtoSOb_BXwjWq9TwRr6oEYwQ1RMWiyS0RGlNuCAa4xWa5Ej27mJTBZgVsxR7lwG7hvMyvIyZ6s8I-UvivuZNF-bBvoQPZ5vEXS-p-C9R9h7i3EWR2tuWzfRfBz34gElpZTgC-VISfquOIoq-XVaGgg1oIBNBV2WidfGk6R8JUHquNNfg82uj6yKBDPSXlX3w%3D)**, your prayers, or your support will go a **TREMENDOUS** way toward getting our country back on track. Together, we can end Biden’s tire shop economy and build a stronger, more prosperous America.

**[Can I count on your help?](http://links.rogersforsenate.com/u/click?_t=b90de78796ce4ce596523293a2b8ff82&_m=6e39c53d0fe14e469aef7509fb0dbb3a&_e=gYF7Pxki9EzRAt9cduiNYiVI2h9D1TjTvK2aXiiIVnfpKV8nlOzrJXv-y4G4UChyw9IM3LLoJfVR3vMIYbwwhufrAzr3TxNsomUBraDL4TzkDwd8yLdfXUwz1SjEKIqGmZwsSsaGz9wIJNuFU84JdEMfnlbiPSBjizcBtaPqOODZ9pKqZ6AbUEUPNJM4wBHJBvLHEA1mO9XNaDTryAqxMraEQo3R3mxpZEyakqYq_GzBtoSOb_BXwjWq9TwRr6oEYwQ1RMWiyS0RGlNuCAa4xS-aR7uB5JvgyElSUDFAiyvxF5eoZFNPSNKjn9G0fvtr5ygZkI4yqT0V_3WMxiUFCjtvBLorrTug0N5CtW7tgwp9L2BAwZukrQkz_h4cEU6uXYPEA_mE9H0_FQTWwTpDE50luMQK_kxLOzUlRYUEMTc%3D)**

| | Greetings #TeamAlsobrooks, Last week on the campaign trail was absolutely spectacular! Thank you to all the folks who came out across the state to support the campaign. Momentum is building across Maryland for Angela’s campaign, and we are so grateful to have your help. Take a look below for some highlights from the campaign trail and beyond!
### **THIS WEEK ON THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL**
Angela spent time in Montgomery County where she was joined by friends and supporters for a wonderful discussion about how she will help deliver for communities of all types across Maryland. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=7&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=8&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV) Angela spent Sunday morning in fellowship at DreamLife Worship Center with Baltimore County Executive Johnny Olszewski. Thank you to Dr. Kenneth Robinson and Pastor Lenyar Robinson for such a powerful service. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=9&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV) Angela was in Gaithersburg, where she got to chat with some remarkable folks about how we can continue to bolster our great state. Special thanks to Elly Shaw Belbidia and Joe and Sue Palka for bringing together your neighbors and friends for a terrific conversation! [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=10&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV) [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=11&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV) At Towson University, Angela was honored to be joined by Congressman John Sarbanes who endorsed her candidacy and helped lead a discussion with student leaders about the importance of defending democracy. Congressman Sarbanes is behind Angela because he knows that the power of the many outweighs the power of money, and we’re so excited to have him on the team. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2570?t=12&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV) The Ravens game isn’t the only big event happening in Baltimore this weekend! On Friday, we are opening our new campaign office in Baltimore to kick-off our organizing efforts. We hope that you can join us to show that Baltimore is on Team Alsobrooks! Sign up here: **[angelaalsobrooks.com/baltimore](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9524?t=13&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV)** [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9524?t=14&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV)
### **NEWS OF THE WEEK**
**[National political reform group backing Alsobrooks in Senate primary](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9936?t=15&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV)**
_End Citizens United // Let America Vote endorses Alsobrooks campaign for Senate_ **[Angela Alsobrooks Sets Maryland Fundraising Record for U.S. Senate Bid](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9937?t=16&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV)**
_We had a record-breaking quarter, outraising all candidates in Maryland history! We are so grateful for the overwhelming support for our campaign, to go further and do better for Marylanders!_ **[WATCH: Prince George's Co. Executive Angela Alsobrooks discusses top priorities for 2024](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9938?t=17&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV)**
_The County Executive shared her plans for Maryland’s future on ABC7news_ **[Snow crews in Prince George's County received a big thank you Friday night](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9939?t=18&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV)**
_CBS WUSA9 shared the County Executive’s visit to the Department of Public Works and Transportation to thank them for their hard work of cleaning up the roads during the snow._
### **CAMPAIGN UPDATES**
We have campaign offices now open in Largo and Silver Spring, with our new office in Baltimore opening today! We’d love to have you join Team Alsobrooks and volunteer to help us get out the vote - **[sign-up here if you’d like to join!](https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=19&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV)** Here on Team Alsobrooks, we’re proud to be a campaign powered by grassroots donors. We believe in Angela's ability to go further and do better for our communities, and we know you do too! It’s going to take all of us working together to get Angela over the finish line this November. | | | [Volunteer](https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=20&akid=983%2E52803%2EbjD5XV)

subject: Have a question about running for Congress? Send it in!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Callie Barr for Congress
body:
| [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77812654/451554754/535718049?refcode=EM_FL_BAR_20240126_fr_ama_cand_nc_90da_xx_hdr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWU2OTRhODAtOGJiYy1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y2YXUNBYyT_DOHFH5B3EcsI9Lw5gbt-RZPtCyAm0c=)
---
Running for Congress has been one of the most humbling and rewarding experiences of my life. Each and every day, I learn something new — about the process, about myself, and about how our elections work. **So, almost a year after beginning this journey, I wanted to take a few minutes and answer some questions I’ve gotten on the campaign trail._[If you have any questions I didn’t get to here, reply to this email and my team and I will answer as many as we can!](mailto:info@calliebarr.com)_** **What’s the money for? Why are you asking for it, and why do we care about how much you raise?** The hardest part about running for office is that it isn’t set up for regular people like me — moms, women, people in the middle class, young (for Congress, at least!). It’s designed for people who are already wealthy, don’t need to work, or have an inside edge. That is because it takes a tremendous amount of money to run TV commercials, hire staff, pay for fliers (you know the thing you hold in your hand ten seconds before it hits the trash - but hopefully gives you enough time to notice a name). It’s that stuff. For our race, we are working to raise two million dollars. That’s insane. But it’s what we need. And, the more we can raise, we show that we have the resources to buy advertisements, travel the district, and hire the people to help us do this. The more we can do those things, the stronger our campaign is, and it helps us get more endorsements and partnerships for getting Bergman out of office. **What’s your dog’s name and what breed is he?** Maloo the malamute. And, no, he won’t be at the UP 200 sled dog races because he’s getting up there in years, and he’s worked hard to maintain his ample figure. **What’s up with all the fundraising deadlines? Are those all made up?** So each month we have target goals to hit to keep us on track (pay staff, save enough for messaging, etc.) Every financial quarter (every three months) we file with the Federal Election Commission. That filing becomes public and people and organizations across the country use it to judge the viability of your campaign (which matters because you’re constantly working to build your network of supporters, endorsements, etc.) **What’s the most rewarding part of running for office?** Building a movement. I’ve been so encouraged by folks I meet who aren’t ready to give up yet — who are courageous enough to believe in something bigger than themselves like standing up for our democracy and our rights to live lives of our choosing. We aren’t in this alone, and together we’re building the infrastructure and coalition we need to make real change. **Who should run for office?** Let’s go for normalish people. Not even normal — just “ish” will do. Ha! _People who care more about their communities than they do about being celebrities._ We’ve got a big job to do, and the only way we can change who represents us is by encouraging real, passionate, dedicated, commonsense people to run, win, and pave the way for others to get involved. **Why is it so hard to run against an incumbent member of Congress like Bergman?** Incumbents have the advantage of institutional barriers _built into the system_ that come with challenging the good ol’ boys club, especially as a woman and mother. For example, Bergman has so much corporate money that it takes a lot of fundraising to be able to message as much as he can. And there’s the age and gender thing. If I had a dollar for every time someone said something about my age or my kids or my gender as if any answer to those questions would be disqualifying, I’d maybe have _more than enough money to take on Rep. Bergman in November._ But here’s the thing — we aren’t exactly dealing with Mr. Popular. I hear from residents in this district all the time, no matter the political party, that Rep. Bergman is completely disengaged from the people in this district - he doesn't listen, he’s never in the district, and he is lacking in providing robust constituent services. We’re gonna win this race, folks. **How can ordinary Michiganders get involved in my campaign?** Right now, there are a few really important things you can do: **1._[Chip in now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77812655/451554755/535718049?refcode=EM_FL_BAR_20240126_fr_ama_cand_nc_90da_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWU2OTRhODAtOGJiYy1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y2YXUNBYyT_DOHFH5B3EcsI9Lw5gbt-RZPtCyAm0c=)_** I know. I know. But — we need to keep fundraising hard to build up the resources needed to take on an entrenched incumbent. While I wish it wasn’t the case, _**[donating now is the most strategic thing you can do to help me win.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77812656/451554756/535718049?refcode=EM_FL_BAR_20240126_fr_ama_cand_nc_90da_xx_l2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWU2OTRhODAtOGJiYy1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y2YXUNBYyT_DOHFH5B3EcsI9Lw5gbt-RZPtCyAm0c=)**_ | [Donate $20.24](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77812657/451554757/535718049?refcode=EM_FL_BAR_20240126_fr_ama_cand_nc_90da_xx_sbt&amount=20.24&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZWU2OTRhODAtOGJiYy1lZTExLWI2NjAtMDAyMjQ4MjIzMTk3IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=I3Y2YXUNBYyT_DOHFH5B3EcsI9Lw5gbt-RZPtCyAm0c=)
---
**2\. Volunteer with a campaign, your local get-out-the-vote club, or nonprofit organization.** Right now, we need help collecting signatures to get on the ballot, and in the coming months we’ll need help knocking doors, talking to voters, and getting our friends and neighbors out to vote! _**[Respond to this email if you’re interested in volunteering with our campaign, and we’ll be in touch!](mailto:info@calliebarr.com)**_
[EMAIL TEAM CALLIE](mailto:info@calliebarr.com)
---
Thank you for the questions! Hopefully, this helps to “pull back the curtain” on what we’re building here and why you matter in all of this. Thank you. Have a great weekend!
Gratefully,
Callie and Team Callie Barr

| Callie Barr is a 5th-generation Michigander, advocate for veterans, and lawyer. She’s running to take on extremism and do-nothing politicians in D.C. that are leaving rural America behind. Can you help send Callie to Congress by donating today?

clean_body: | = Running for Congress has been one of the most humbling and rewarding experiences of my life. Each and every day, I learn something new — about the process, about myself, and about how our elections work. So, almost a year after beginning this journey, I wanted to take a few minutes and answer some questions I’ve gotten on the campaign trail.mailto:info@calliebarr.com What’s the money for? Why are you asking for it, and why do we care about how much you raise? The hardest part about running for office is that it isn’t set up for regular people like me — moms, women, people in the middle class, young (for Congress, at least!). It’s designed for people who are already wealthy, don’t need to work, or have an inside edge. That is because it takes a tremendous amount of money to run TV commercials, hire staff, pay for fliers (you know the thing you hold in your hand ten seconds before it hits the trash - but hopefully gives you enough time to notice a name). It’s that stuff. For our race, we are working to raise two million dollars. That’s insane. But it’s what we need. And, the more we can raise, we show that we have the resources to buy advertisements, travel the district, and hire the people to help us do this. The more we can do those things, the stronger our campaign is, and it helps us get more endorsements and partnerships for getting Bergman out of office. What’s your dog’s name and what breed is he? Maloo the malamute. And, no, he won’t be at the UP 200 sled dog races because he’s getting up there in years, and he’s worked hard to maintain his ample figure. What’s up with all the fundraising deadlines? Are those all made up? So each month we have target goals to hit to keep us on track (pay staff, save enough for messaging, etc.) Every financial quarter (every three months) we file with the Federal Election Commission. That filing becomes public and people and organizations across the country use it to judge the viability of your campaign (which matters because you’re constantly working to build your network of supporters, endorsements, etc.) What’s the most rewarding part of running for office? Building a movement. I’ve been so encouraged by folks I meet who aren’t ready to give up yet — who are courageous enough to believe in something bigger than themselves like standing up for our democracy and our rights to live lives of our choosing. We aren’t in this alone, and together we’re building the infrastructure and coalition we need to make real change. Who should run for office? Let’s go for normalish people. Not even normal — just “ish” will do. Ha! People who care more about their communities than they do about being celebrities. We’ve got a big job to do, and the only way we can change who represents us is by encouraging real, passionate, dedicated, commonsense people to run, win, and pave the way for others to get involved. Why is it so hard to run against an incumbent member of Congress like Bergman? Incumbents have the advantage of institutional barriers built into the system that come with challenging the good ol’ boys club, especially as a woman and mother. For example, Bergman has so much corporate money that it takes a lot of fundraising to be able to message as much as he can. And there’s the age and gender thing. If I had a dollar for every time someone said something about my age or my kids or my gender as if any answer to those questions would be disqualifying, I’d maybe have more than enough money to take on Rep. Bergman in November. But here’s the thing — we aren’t exactly dealing with Mr. Popular. I hear from residents in this district all the time, no matter the political party, that Rep. Bergman is completely disengaged from the people in this district - he doesn't listen, he’s never in the district, and he is lacking in providing robust constituent services. We’re gonna win this race, folks. How can ordinary Michiganders get involved in my campaign? Right now, there are a few really important things you can do: 1.= I know. I know. But — we need to keep fundraising hard to build up the resources needed to take on an entrenched incumbent. While I wish it wasn’t the case, = | = 2\. Volunteer with a campaign, your local get-out-the-vote club, or nonprofit organization. Right now, we need help collecting signatures to get on the ballot, and in the coming months we’ll need help knocking doors, talking to voters, and getting our friends and neighbors out to vote! mailto:info@calliebarr.com mailto:info@calliebarr.com Thank you for the questions! Hopefully, this helps to “pull back the curtain” on what we’re building here and why you matter in all of this. Thank you. Have a great weekend! Gratefully, Callie and Team Callie Barr | Callie Barr is a 5th-generation Michigander, advocate for veterans, and lawyer. She’s running to take on extremism and do-nothing politicians in D.C. that are leaving rural America behind. Friend —
I was proud to stand on the debate stage in Los Angeles and share our campaign’s unifying message directly with the people of California.
But there’s something I can’t get off my mind. Before I share more, will you split $15 between Seth Moulton and my campaign to help me defeat MAGA enablers and stand up for Californians in the Senate? With just a few days until early voting begins, our campaign is working day and night to earn every last vote. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
In the middle of the debate, my Republican opponent Steve Garvey refused to say whether he’d support Donald Trump — saying “When the time comes...I’ll make my choice.”
That’s an unacceptable answer. So I asked him plainly: What more do you need to denounce Donald Trump?
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]
For Steve Garvey, it wasn’t enough that Donald Trump undermined our alliance with NATO.
Or that he threw our country’s national security under the bus to buddy up with Vladimir Putin.
Or that he dismantled Roe v. Wade and stripped millions of women of their reproductive freedom.
Or that he incited the January 6 insurrection and attempted to overthrow the government.
That’s where Steve Garvey and I differ.
I was censured by MAGA Republicans for standing up to the corrupt president. And I would do it again.
I’m not afraid to say that Donald Trump is a danger to our country. So is Mitch McConnell. And Jim Jordan. And the rest of his MAGA enablers who’ve worked tirelessly to hide the truth.
The people of California deserve to know whether Steve Garvey believes that a President who incited a violent attack on the Capitol should be trusted with power again. If he can’t answer the most basic of questions, he cannot be trusted to represent Californians in the Senate.
I am the strongest candidate to take on MAGA enablers like Steve Garvey and deliver for Californians in the Senate. With early voting beginning in just a matter of days, will you rush in $15 to split between Seth Moulton and my campaign to win this race? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/m23-schiff]

Adam

name: TN House Democrats
subject: Legislative Update | Jan 26 2024
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tennessee House Democratic Caucus | Ronnie Glynn, Treasurer
body:
https://tnhousedems.com/ [https://tnhousedems.com/]
January 26, 2024
OUR FIGHT FOR WORKING FAMILIES CONTINUES
GOODBYE TO A BELOVED LAWYER, LAWMAKER AND FRIEND
We begin this week’s newsletter with a tribute to former state representative Frank Buck who
passed away this week at the age of 80. Easily recognizable in his signature khaki pants and
leather vest, Rep. Buck represented the people of District 40 as a Democrat in the Tennessee
House of Representatives for 36 years. He possessed a sharp legal mind, a lively personality and a fierce passion for serving his fellow Tennesseans. The entire House Democratic Caucus extends its sincere condolences to the Buck family.
Visitation is scheduled for this Saturday, January 27th from 3 p.m. to 7 p.m. and Sunday, January 28th from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. His celebration of life will be held Sunday, Jan. 28 at 2 p.m. at Love Cantrell Funeral Home, located at 100 East Church Street in Smithville, Tennessee.
BACK TO WORK
The legislature returned to work this week after winter weather kept legislators at home in their
districts all last week.
Turning up the heat on Lee’s “Chief Education Privatization Officer”
Your House Democratic Caucus hit the ground running with a press conference early Monday
morning during which Chairman John Ray Clemmons, Rep. Sam McKenzie and Rep. Ronnie Glynn called on Commissioner Lizzette Reynolds, Gov. Bill Lee’s recently appointed education commissioner, to resign. Tennessee law outlining the qualifications for the commissioner is “neither vague nor optional,” argued Chairman Clemmons. Tenn. Code. “Shall means shall,” noted Chairman Clemmons. Commissioner Reynolds’ resume clearly demonstrates that she fails to satisfy any of the three requirements set forth in the plain language of the statute. Because she is legally unqualified to serve, Rep. Sam McKenzie stated that if Commissioner Reynolds will not resign then Governor Lee must replace her.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP03/1/68714/images/JRC%20and%20Mckenzie.jpg]
Rep. Glynn stands firm against House Republicans’ proposal to reject federal funds
As the lone House Democrat appointed to the Joint Working Group on Federal Education Funding formed by Speaker Cameron Sexton to study his inane proposal to reject federal [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP03/1/68714/images/Glynn_DSC06544.jpg]
education funds, which total approximately $1.8 billion per year, Rep. Ronnie Glynn enjoyed a front row seat to several days of testimony from witnesses who spoke to the fiscally
irresponsibility of Sexton’s proposal.
Following Senate Republicans’ release of a 12-page report that outlined their fiscal concerns with such a proposal, House Republicans released a letter recommending further consideration of Sexton’s proposal. Rep. Glynn outright refused to sign the letter the Republicans asked him to
sign. In explaining his refusal, Rep. Glynn said, “it’s a terrible idea that would only serve to harm our children and schools.”
Representative Glynn added that it is resoundingly clear that rejecting federal education funds is a bad idea and released a statement which states, in part:
“I cannot support such a fiscally irresponsible proposal that would effectively double-bill Montgomery County families and provide no additional benefit to our students and, in several cases, even less services to those who need them most. I will not support placing more financial burden on the shoulders of local officials and my constituents who would inevitably end up paying higher property taxes. If our state has the ability to spend over a billion more dollars annually on public education, then we should invest that money in our public school students, teachers and school buildings. Rejecting federal education dollars is a bad idea and would be a grave mistake.”
Rep. Aftyn Behn continues Democrats’ long-time push to end the grocery tax
Continuing House Democrats’ push to lower costs for working families, freshman
Representative Aftyn Behn filed legislation this week to permanently end the grocery tax in
Tennessee. HB2043 [https://wapp.capitol.tn.gov/apps/BillInfo/Default.aspx?BillNumber=HB2043&ga=113] would eliminate the current 4% sales tax on groceries and replace the
revenues with a tax on large corporations who are currently failing to pay their fair share.
Tennessee is one of only 13 states that taxes groceries, and our grocery tax is one of the highest in the nation. Studies have shown that a grocery tax hits lower income families the hardest and literally prevents them from putting food on their table. It unjustly forces these working families to pay a higher percentage of their income to meet their basic needs and make ends meet.
Rep. Behn has received support from across the state. “From Chattanooga to Memphis,
Tennesseans desperately want this...They want it, and we have the way to make it work.”
Retailers support the tax with many grocery owners say they saw a big increase in people
shopping and buying during the recent grocery tax-freeze, which was originally proposed by
House Democrats and adopted by Gov. Bill Lee.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP03/1/68714/images/Behn.jpg]
Unanswered questions on franchise and excise tax proposal require answers
Caucus Chairman John Ray Clemmons asked Governor Bill Lee and other Republican
administration officials for the legal reasoning behind his proposed changes to the state’s
franchise and excise tax laws. Lee has vaguely referenced a likely proposal that would simplify
how franchise taxes are calculated and stated that the changes are necessary because of legal advice from the Attorney General and the Department of Revenue. Chairman Clemmons
believes that caucus members and the public deserve to know exactly what this legal reasoning is before Democrats take a position on the issue.
In his letter sent to the governor, the attorney general, and the commissioners of Revenue and F&A, Clemmons requested a copy of any and all non-privileged legal opinions and
documentation that are resulting in the governor’s proposed changes to the long-standing tax laws. Clemmons argued that given the significant fiscal impact that any such change would have on the lives of working families and the provision of state services, the public deserves to know the legal justification and rationale for the governor’s pricey proposal.
You can read the letter on the following page.

body:
Last week, I reached out with a survey asking you what members of our coalition need from the federal government

Hi, When I worked for the national preschool program Head Start guiding public policy, my bosses were parents of kids in the program. It framed the way I worked, and confirmed my strong belief that all policy should be developed with the people who are impacted at the table. It just makes sense. I carry that lesson with me every day. Last year, I heard from countless constituents about how rising costs made it hard to get by. So I rolled up my sleeves and helped to pass historic tax cuts for Michigan working families – letting you put more of your hard earned money towards the things that matter, like housing, childcare, and groceries. Last week, I reached out with a survey asking you what members of our coalition need from the federal government. Here is what you said: **protecting the right to abortion, ending gun violence and protecting Social Security and Medicare.** I couldn’t agree more. We can’t let extremists make American women less free and less safe. We can’t let our kids grow up in a world where their lives are at risk every time they leave the house. And we can’t leave our seniors out in the cold when they’ve worked for years to support their families and retire with dignity. **That’s why I’m running for Congress.** We need leaders in the House who will participate in our communities, listen, and work with normal people on both sides to get things done. [_**But getting to Congress won’t be easy. I’m running in one of the most competitive districts in the country, and Republicans are desperate to win this race. So, can I count on you to chip in to my campaign so I can get to Congress and deliver for Michigan’s families?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77815116/451563173/1532741920?refcode=email_012624_Survey-followup-B&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOWFmNmRhNS05M2JjLWVlMTEtYjY2MC0wMDIyNDgyMjMxOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dfZ14jh-iwIfDDWcGFYNrRJeRkKZaS9eHE5dMZ0g2N8=) Thanks, Kristen

Fellow American,

I want to introduce myself.

My name is Nella Domenici – I’m a proud New Mexican, devoted mother, wife of a Navy veteran, businesswoman, and I’m excited to announce to you that **I am running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico.**

**It’s not breaking news for me to say our nation and state are clearly on the wrong track.**

To say that Joe Biden and my opponent Martin Heinrich’s policies have failed us seems inadequate – _it’s like they don’t even understand us._

**The cost of living is way up, the border is wide open, our crime and drug crises are out of control, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.**

Hardworking New Mexicans are suffering from these failures. We need new leadership in Washington who will improve, energize, and restore hope to our state and our country.

[**That’s why I’m running for Senate, and I’m asking for your support to help me restore fiscally conservative, commonsense, and impactful leadership both in New Mexico and the U.S. Senate by making a Week One donation to my campaign today.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=77d772b3bd9949d3bd8be5dadc91834f&_e=_vwhwL2czukgZLtx27yxAmyiSaW5yk8zWrh3Q32k-1nli1w2YHKJkJ3a_a-fHiGQfeHQ98gE1f4PFiZFi2juC9xXpYJ9isO0T85a6OOEKdPNlhCkO8fn8xwKDzoZ9A0rTFE2Kz7yQsVKITZpD_zM271hEyVPglHkQHtA4LlO5c4Je5Ze5qo_1uZvbhd3tAhlWJ9yuQwN6yAHoiyb8QikEofR8racZ8OJmF2nNotoj02ytx0DyX55IKJMZDUtyw4rVFw3Tel5y4cw3TOgQPGi9j-EiK1JUn_DI3ix4K3QKelvAxlRcH5lGqyQFPqVGyRuGwAv9ARAHKwJZBC_J_A1utVHgf1015Z9wNQXesjcrjsdcRo_QEC8MSF2cNdHSmQfRxkIki3lY6tt73zlt72hTA%3D%3D)

[ ** JOIN THE FIGHT WITH NELLA » **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=77d772b3bd9949d3bd8be5dadc91834f&_e=_vwhwL2czukgZLtx27yxAmyiSaW5yk8zWrh3Q32k-1nli1w2YHKJkJ3a_a-fHiGQfeHQ98gE1f4PFiZFi2juC9xXpYJ9isO0T85a6OOEKdPNlhCkO8fn8xwKDzoZ9A0rTFE2Kz7yQsVKITZpD_zM271hEyVPglHkQHtA4LlO5c4Je5Ze5qo_1uZvbhd3tAhlWJ9yuQwN6yAHoiyb8QikEofR8racZ8OJmF2nNotoj02uGs9MqVr-V5sraIHQ8y-XtaWUtkM5aPlEOViCR7rWh8UxCUb1PL2_L4islzBW4RIe4t2jmWKucFUnDZoYNJ1_-EHdHS_1fpLj0d4Hj55mDYGfXeyBR162o_3m1-jH0o9U9CA-5VjcIIJneJlV2IxEACTuqf2-M1Nod5JU5xPA9g%3D%3D)
New Mexico is my home. **My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned.**

I understand the importance of hard work, like most New Mexicans. I waited tables to help pay for my undergraduate degree from Georgetown University. While holding down a full-time job, I paid my way through night school at Georgetown Law. I also paid for Harvard Business School, graduating as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while nine months pregnant.

I began my career at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I have advised, invested in, grown, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. **Collectively, the companies I have been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.**

I am uniquely prepared and qualified to fight for a significantly improved New Mexican economy. | | | **Reflect and Act: International Holocaust Remembrance Day**
---

Dear Peter,
Tomorrow, on International Holocaust Remembrance Day, we join together to honor the memory of the six million Jews and countless others who suffered unimaginable horrors during the Holocaust. This day is a solemn reminder of the atrocities that can arise from hatred and intolerance, and it reinforces our commitment to ensuring such darkness never descends again.
While deployed to West Berlin in the 90s, I was able to see the devastation and impacts of the Holocaust. The world cannot forget, or we’re liable to repeat the horrors of inhumanity. Our campaign is dedicated to upholding the lessons of the Holocaust, promoting understanding and acceptance, and fighting against all forms of discrimination and bigotry.
But to make our efforts impactful, we need your support.

---
| | | |
---
|
Would you consider contributing $20, $50, or $100 to help us:

* Educate our community about the Holocaust and its enduring lessons.
* Support initiatives that foster dialogue and combat antisemitism.
* Work towards policies that encourage tolerance and safeguard human rights.

Carmen Goers

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

Hello, all - and a belated Happy New Year! I skipped a newsletter to focus on holidays and work. As most of you know, I started a publishing company back in 2007 in Baker City. That's still my day job! One of my authors, Steven B. Epstein, was featured last week on Dateline NBC in the "Family Matters" episode with his book, [EXTREME PUNISHMENT](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/2p2nbTGCEyfqJZBZPw-3PQ~~/AAAHUQA~). In March, we have [KILLING TIME](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/9axegmhBlRRXPtuTsUmwFA~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRnlrFhP0UgNjE4YWRjNzNmODc4ZmJjMmRhMzRlODg0MTg4ZjQ0ZDNEvWh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LmFtYXpvbi5jb20vS2lsbGluZy1UaW1lLUpvaG4tV2F5bmUtR2FjeS1lYm9vay9kcC9CMENSOUdQU0RHL3JlZj1zcl8xXzE_Y3JpZD1NNzhVUUdZNlo3RTQma2V5d29yZHM9a2FyZW4rY29udGkmcWlkPTE3MDYzMDUyOTQmcz1kaWdpdGFsLXRleHQmc3ByZWZpeD0lMkNkaWdpdGFsLXRleHQlMkMxMzA4JnNyPTEtMVcFc3BjZXVCCmWyYSy0ZbDUfAZSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAF9j) by John Wayne Gacy's death row attorney coming out. Busy!

Now, with the RNC meeting coming up next week in Vegas, it's back to politics. Solomon has written and sponsored a hard-hitting immigration bill, which I think will pass easily. (More on that next time.) I'm happy to see so many Republican governors stand with Texas against this invasion.

We do have big news from Baker County! Our new **National Federation of Republican Women President Julie Harris is coming to Oregon!** If you follow the news, you'll know what an important election this was for the organization.
For the first time, the Oregon Federation of Republican Women is holding its annual Spring Board Meeting in Baker City, scheduled in conjunction with our banquet. I enjoyed talking with Julie a couple months back, and was thrilled when she agreed to be our keynote speaker. Congressman Cliff Bentz (CD2) will speak. A variety of candidates and other elected officials will attend - and that list is growing!
I know our club is excited to welcome members of other Republican women’s clubs from across the state - and likely neighboring states! Tickets ARE available to the public as this will be a fun event for the community as well. Live music by Frank Carlson (who sounds a lot like Elvis IMO). Door prizes. Live auction. Chicken or tri-tip...
All proceeds go to fund our future Baker County patriot kids camp, teaching real, accurate American history and constitutional principles - not the woke stuff.
Hope to see you all there!

_Kerry_

All issues that many Republicans in competitive races dodge talking about because they know their positions are unpopular. Martin will always stand up for our shared values. | | **[Today, I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=7940a6b22e2f43feb06c6662cbc8750f&_e=rd6rSkUcqgfQkWKPKQYQabYChs0rSsgrGLMXkZQ3XIRjhu0E1AEhJVsGOuvyTEdeatcOuCMRXkyBRMuuMEyq0uYWhRxJul2JsYl4nbcTwyCQept8DnlqL7vUCjTeRO9SDOaD7pWEQWN6AaqAPOhZIXrtNW9lc2bWdxCnwUcDM3CXqo5v3zrvuOI8Q6Jh9peyh9t5V51DDQLrnSbbRFKArGLDNN7P2buTotliVoo-roIM6z4a7oKp8dEhFUdeMF_C3QisGNP0Eq5Uey1hMCGu3jRp-4C1VpTsu7ZXaYQ6_054Jb-e6NAHaAhx2gQBdYClmiS-jhjDkNZLTGeBELe49o8XL1WACu-sR0U3i45zPbW2f46xBM6qTTitiBGAF_mI3EW764xonnRwWPtd7wwfZw%3D%3D)** Democrat policies have brought America to its knees. There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California. Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent. And that's why I'm running for Senate. **We Republicans pulled our country out of the 1970 's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.** And I believe we can do it again by putting classic conservative values at the heart of everything we do. But there is no way I can pull it off without you. **[**Will you rush a contribution to my campaign of $15 or more today?**](http://links.rightwaypress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=7940a6b22e2f43feb06c6662cbc8750f&_e=rd6rSkUcqgfQkWKPKQYQabYChs0rSsgrGLMXkZQ3XIRjhu0E1AEhJVsGOuvyTEdeatcOuCMRXkyBRMuuMEyq0uYWhRxJul2JsYl4nbcTwyCQept8DnlqL7vUCjTeRO9SDOaD7pWEQWN6AaqAPOhZIXrtNW9lc2bWdxCnwUcDM3CXqo5v3zrvuOI8Q6Jh9peyh9t5V51DDQLrnSbbRFKArGLDNN7P2buTotliVoo-roLizKC_9k5_WQ1djt-_qtVdx6gu3GmHjN2VE7CZf72kDxLV1iceapE-nyNdp22p3wj3mYyoZa1oMRv5ZYkQD_x7Ix8EKQ6dE_aZav4nuqhdsuAj8A9IOnonj9XB7AxIcvfvv-3D0UJ94ze-E_AVLW2sbdObV32NJ3d8bD5v3j8RuQ%3D%3D)** The California primary is coming up in fast on March 5th and I need to have as many conservative Republican's like you on my side as possible. In California's primary the top two vote-getters make it to the general election. And right now the polls show Adam Schiff polling at #1 and I'm hot on his heels at #2. Once we're passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him in November. Why? First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -\- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before. They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California... I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a **Republican win**. I'm fighting for the soul of the state I love -- but make no mistake -- I'm not just taking the field for Californians. When we win here... when we rip this seat out the hands of the radical Adam Schiff... **...we start the nationwide Republican Comeback Rally our country desperately needs.** Thank you and God Bless,

name: Katie Porter
subject: My three kids most shape my worldview and work in Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
When I fight for affordable housing, I think of crunching the numbers with my oldest son, Luke, who was worried about attending college in California because of the high cost of housing.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=37015%2E3422442%2Eh6_sDV)
Derek, during Monday’s debate I was asked which person has most shaped my worldview. The answer is easy: **my three school-aged kids.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240126-2?refcode=em20240126-37015&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=37015_3422442_h6_sDV&akid=37015%2E3422442%2Eh6_sDV)
Now, while I won’t be choosing a favorite amongst them, they all keep me squarely focused on the future.
When I fight for affordable housing, I think of crunching the numbers with my oldest son, Luke, who was worried about attending college in California because of the high cost of housing.
When I hold Big Oil accountable, I think of Paul, who had a sign on his door that read “Zero emissions 2030 or do not enter.”
When I fight for capping child care costs at 7% of a family’s income, I think of my daughter Betsy, whose preschool cost me more than college tuition would have.
Luke, Paul, and Betsy all make me a better representative, and they’re what inspire me to fight even on the longest, toughest of days.
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240126-2?refcode=em20240126-37015&refcode2=37015_3422442_h6_sDV&akid=37015%2E3422442%2Eh6_sDV)
Thanks for reading,
Katie Porter

body:
Here's the truth.

Peter, we have an election coming up in Orange County in just a few weeks.

This is our opportunity to replace liberal Katie Porter in California's 47th District not just with a Republican, but with an America First conservative.

That's why I'm running. I'm just asking you for one thing today ... and that's your endorsement. (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/vote-pledge?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=TenDays_MeetMax_12624)

Let me take a moment to re-introduce myself.
ENDORSE MAX FOR CA-47 (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/vote-pledge?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=TenDays_MeetMax_12624)
My name is Max Ukropina. I'm a Republican. I'm an America First conservative. I'm a business owner. I was born and raised right here in Orange County.

Most importantly, I'm not a career politician. I'm a political outsider with a sense of real urgency running to fight for Orange County and bring real America First leadership to Washington.

Here's the truth: politicians from both parties - including Republicans - have been lying to us for a long time. They say one thing to us when they want our votes but become complacent in Washington.

I'm running because I believe that Republicans who are complacent are complicit in the problem.

I'm 36 years old. I love my country, but our border is being overrun. Our cost-of-living is unaffordable. Our national debt is in a tailspin.

I'm sorry, but I don't have time to be complacent.

Do you?

I'm running for Congress because I believe our Republican leaders need to act with URGENCY and BOLDNESS in everything they do!

We need more America First patriots in Washington willing to stand up and say enough is enough.

ADD YOUR NAME and ENDORSE my campaign for Congress and join our movement to bring America First leadership to Washington! (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/vote-pledge?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=TenDays_MeetMax_12624)

Thank you and God bless America,

Friends -
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and his longest serving cabinet secretary.
The DeVos family has supported opponents of mine in the past, and it looks like they’re ready to double down on this Senate race.
**One of Republican Mike Rogers' first FEC reports was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family — contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day, just before last year's September 30th deadline.**
Mike Rogers has already started to see a flood of support from deep-pocketed Republican donors like Betsy DeVos, corporate PACs, and Super PACs who will all spend millions of dollars on his behalf in order to flip Michigan red. In 2020, the DeVos family contributed over $1.6 million to candidates and PACs which have spent over $10 million to super PACs to influence races like ours.
So these contributions are likely just the beginning of the support Mike Rogers will receive from this powerful family.
But this campaign has something Mike Rogers' campaign lacks: lots and lots of regular people giving what they can, when they can.
Just one peek behind-the-curtain of a recent Mike Rogers' FEC report shows he raised less than 5% of his money from individuals making small-dollar donations.
By contrast, the majority of the donations we receive come from people contributing significantly smaller donations than the DeVos family made to Mike Rogers.
And what you may not know is that the single greatest source of individual donations to our campaign is the response to emails like this.
That’s why I would love to earn your support today.
